tieu_de: Living Buddha Te Gong
Biography of the Living Buddha Te Gong
noi_dung:
Biography

LIVING BUDDHA JI KONG

Living Buddha JI KONG lived in the Southern Song dynasty (1150-1209), originally from Thien Thai district, Zhejiang province, family name Tu Duyen, took refuge at Linh Pagoda Hidden in West Lake, Hangzhou, the dharma name Dao Te, because he often used tricks to pretend to be crazy to save lives, people often jokingly called him Te Dien. The Living Buddha's body is the incarnation of the Golden Body Arhat, the Golden Dragon Venerable, deeply understanding samadhi, that is, right concentration, calming the mind to meditate in order to achieve a state of carefree intuition in order to thoroughly comprehend and realize the Buddha Dharma, meaning: "All dharmas inherently appear because of the mind" (All dharmas exist only in the mind). And directly cultivating the Buddha's mind without relying on means, it should be said: "Cultivate the mind without cultivating the mouth to become a living Buddha" (Cultivate the mind without cultivating mouth, the monks and nuns at that time only "precepts the mouth" and not "precepts the mind", so the Living Buddha spoke a warning voice to help them become enlightened. He has great supernatural powers, saves humanity, defends danger, and often mocks those who are good and specialize in evil deeds to make them enlightened.But especially for the evildoers who did not know how to repent, he directly attacked without hesitation, making people very happy, so it was not by accident that people called him a holy monk and revered him as the Living Buddha.

The Living Buddha used to live in Tinh Tu Pagoda. The pagoda had a fire and needed wood for restoration. The Living Buddha traveled to Nghiem Lang, used his robe to cover the mountains, uprooted the trees and let them float to Hangzhou. He returned to inform the monks in the pagoda that "the wood is in the Huong Tich well".

Around the year Gia Dinh (1209), he passed away and was buried at Ho Pao tower. At his death, he composed a song:

Song written

Six Decades of Lang Ta
East Bich Da Dau Tay Bich
U Kim Gathers Quy Lai
Yu old water lotus sky wall.

Sing that

Sixty years of my life are shattered
The eastern wall pushes against the western wall
Gathering forever still comes up empty handed
The water suddenly becomes a cloudy blue sky.

After entering nirvana, a monk met the Living Buddha at the foot of the Luc Hoa tower. In the letter sent back, there was attached a poem as follows:

Poetry

The memory of the front is the same as seeing off
The consciousness
Huu Qua Thien Thai passed away for a while.

Translation

Remembering the past in front of my eyes, blocking flying arrows
Why are my bones and flesh cold now
My face asks who can remember
My Thien Thai has come again to be happy.

So the Bodhisattva promised to return to earth. The Buddha lived his entire life to save and transform, walking around the human world to provoke anger and laughter, without worrying or shyness, cultivating "the practice of asceticism, practicing the Bodhisattva way, wearing a ragged robe, enjoying the worldly life. His torn shoes were soaked in mud, he held a fan in his hand, he was not afraid of high or low, the top of his head was shining brightly, the wind did not beat him, the rain did not bury him, so did he still need a conical hat? Vacuum, cold and heat are not violated, why do you need clothes? Don't beg for alms because you're not hungry or thirsty. Lazy and dignified because of the lack of fur, humorous and laughing, making good relationships widely, not hiding from the world, looking for a voice to save suffering, hundreds of families vying for respect, boundless compassion, wonderful virtue, no monk who has retreated to live in seclusion in the deep mountains and valleys can compare. Every word and every word is like a sharp thorn and taunting knife, leaving home from the tolerant intellectual region of Ngu Nhac, so in the next life any Buddha who considers himself noble will avoid talking about it.Therefore, a high level of holy monks was lost and could not be revealed. Fortunately, my Buddha was compassionate and did not complain, did not get depressed, lived beyond worldly attachments, demonstrated meditation everywhere, practiced Buddhism with full of joyful nuances, so the great name "Zen Master" resonated everywhere. The great spirit of the world transformed into positive merits of entering the world, is truly a shining example for those today who study Buddhism and practice the Way, so when life bestows the holy name "Living Buddha", it is very reasonable.

Nowadays, when the Dharma ends, sentient beings are burned by the fire of desire, immersed in the sea of ​​suffering, the Living Buddha is determined to save people, so the magical powers of the past are once again revealed, vowing to reincarnate again, descend to the Holy Sage Hall, guide the original spirit Yang Sheng to visit the underworld, and collect authentic evidence to warn the world. From there, the secrets of hell were revealed, creating magnetic boats to save sentient beings. Those who are blessed to be bathed in the rain of Dharma will forever stay away from evil paths. How great, the great work has been completed, it remains forever, remembering the great virtue.

WRITING PROCEDURE

Confronting the song, returning to the world of delusion
One smile on the flower, the original method of meditation
Life is like a play, acting with ecstasy and transforming
All dharmas return to the mind, transform into hell and paradise.

PROCEEDING

Duong Sinh: Teacher, what place is this? In front there is a large palace, crowded with people, it is difficult to see clearly.

Buddhist offerings: In front is the First Palace of the underworld. Let's quickly go see Qin Quang Vuong(King of the underworld). Qin Quang Vuong (Ming Vuong, king of the underworld): Receiving the Living Buddha Ji Cong and the saintly writer Duong Thien Sinh from Thanh Hien Duong in Taichung to visit the palace.

Duong Sinh: Please see Vuong Minh, today I followed the Buddha to work in the royal palace. If there is any mistake, please forgive me.

Minh Vuong: Don't be polite, please follow me into the palace. Please settle down at the Guest House. Hey General, quickly offer me some tea.

General: Please obey my orders.

Minh Vuong: We respectfully invite Buddha and Duong Thien Sinh to have tea.

Buddhist worship: Duong Sinh, it's nothing important, drink it, why are you holding back?

Duong Sinh: I don't dare to drink because I heard people say that if mortals go to the underworld to eat or drink anything, they will definitely not be able to return to the earthly world. So please, teacher and Minh Vuong, please use it.

Minh Vuong: Duong Thien Sinh said it wrong. It is said that earthly people cannot eat dishes from the underworld, that is generally true for everyone. Yin and yang each place has its master, of course, discipline cannot be disrupted. But what about the case where the person who obeys the Jade Emperor's order and comes down here is among the distinguished guests, and also has the Buddha to guide him, can't he return to the earthly world?

Buddhist worship: Duong Sinh, rest assured, you have the Jade Emperor's edict within you. Any demon child who dares to block the road, if anyone dares to violate the edict, will definitely be punished without mercy. Don't be afraid, just drink!

Minh Vuong: People in the world are eager to live and afraid of death. There is a reason why Duong Sinh is afraid of death and does not dare to drink tea. But in this world, there is a type of person who clearly understands that, by doing wrong and evil things, there is only one way to die, but still refuses to turn back, keeps rushing forward, rushing straight to the grave. It's truly pitiful.

Duong Sinh: I have finished drinking tea, my mouth is also thirsty. May I ask, why are there so many people lining up outside?

King Minh: I take care of the First Palace, after mortals die, they must first go to the Hall of Yin

Duong Gioi declared. Then the soldiers escorted the soul to the shrine. The telegram transferred the background records and the litigant to the underworld court, so that I could investigate clearly the good and evil. Those who do good deeds are taken to see the palaces in the underworld. Or depending on the fate with a certain teacher, you can go back to practice again. There are also cases where they are taken to Ti Thuong Thien or So Tu Thien. People who commit many crimes are sent to the Second Palace or the Crime Department. If the crime is too serious, they will first be escorted to Nghiet Canh Dai and shown their true form so that the sinner must bow his head to accept the crime. Then return to the Second Palace.

Duong Sinh: Outside there was the endless wailing and mourning of the souls. I don't understand why all children, young and old, are so pitiful?

Minh Vuong: When mortals come to the temple, they clearly know that they have left this world. When they were alive, they did not believe in ghosts and gods and karma. When I came here, I realized that when we die, not everything happens, everything disappears. Hence

sentence: "Nhat dan is impermanent and all things are empty, the path of the underworld only exists and is harmful to the body" (one day everything changes and nothing remains, only still has bad causes that follow you on the road to the underworld). The ghost knows clearly that he will be punished by the laws of the underworld and must endure punishment. So there are many people whose hearts are cold, their bodies tremble, they cry and ask questions. They have to give up their loved ones in the earthly world, such as beautiful wives and smart children, tall houses, wide doors, pearls, gold and silver, and end love. Currently, there is only a lonely body left at the golden stream. Every time I remember the past, I can't hold back the tears of sadness.

Duong Sinh: Why don't the underworld soldiers respect the souls, use weapons, or use whips to beat them, making the souls sob like winter cicadas, it's so pitiful!

Minh Vuong: These spirits live without morals in the world, so the underworld soldiers not only do not keep rituals but also mistreat them according to their crimes. Truly, "Evil people have their own evil demons. The type of pride and speculation." If in this world they knew how to let mercy save their lives, when they died, the soldiers of the underworld would treat them many times better. There's no need to defend them.

Duong Sinh: If you do not cultivate your mind while living, after death you will be extremely pitiful. If in future generations, descendants know that their ancestors were considered equal to criminals when they died and were beaten and beaten by evil spirits, they will definitely not be willing. The way to repay people's gratitude to their ancestors is to cultivate and practice good deeds to gain the merit of transcending the ancestors' souls to one day be free from suffering.

Buddhist worship: If people in this world do not maintain family discipline and act indiscriminately, their ancestors will certainly be implicated. Therefore, it is said that the "Nine Mysterious Seven Patriarchs" bloodline is closely related and the cause and effect cycle is intimate, so we must be very careful. It's almost time today, prepare to return to Thanh Hien Duong.

Minh Vuong: A farewell.

Buddhist offerings: Duong Sinh quickly climbed up to the lotus platform to prepare to return.....Having arrived at Thanh Hien Duong, Duong Sinh got down from the lotus platform, his soul entering his body.

tieu_de: Chapter 6: Walking in the Mirror of Evil Karma to See the Sinful Soul Reveal its Original Form
noi_dung:
Chapter Six

THE MIRROR OF EVIL KARMA
SEE THE SIN SHOWING IN THEIR OWN FORM

The Living Buddha Ji Cong Christmas on the 6th day of the 8th month of the year of the Fire Thin (1976)

Poetry

The soul of Nghiet Kinh shows its original form
Reduces self-recording of dark texts and adds sutras
The law of impartiality and real judgment
Yang and evildoers show their original form.

Translation

The soul reflects in the mirror of evil, revealing its true form
Omitting words and tacitly changing the scriptures
The law of justice in hell
People who commit evil in the world are severely punished.

Buddhist worship: It's time to visit hell today, Duong Sinh prepares to leave.

Duong Sinh: Dear, I have finished preparing, please depart...

Buddhist worship: We have arrived, quickly get down to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Where is this? As for that large group of people, why were they escorted to the stage by underworld soldiers?

Sacrificing to Buddha: This is Nghiet Kinh Dai (Mirror tower reflecting evil karma). As for the crowd of people who do not maintain morality, specializing in unjust and evil things in the world, now they are all devils who commit crimes. After death, they must report at the First Palace, then be escorted to the stage, so that the mirror of evil karma will show the true form of all the crimes they committed while on earth. Once the sins in this world have been exposed, the sinful soul can no longer cover up the punishment in the afterlife. Most of these ghosts, when brought on stage, trembled because they were afraid that their bad habits would be exposed and make many people laugh. Let's follow them to the radio to watch.

Duong Sinh: That's right, if you look carefully you can fully understand the situation. General of the Tower (General of the Station): Welcome to visit Living Buddha Ji Cong and Duong Thien Sinh of Thanh Hien Duong in Taichung.

Buddhist worship: Please forgive me, we teachers and students are under orders to visit the underworld to write books. Come here today, please let the General take Duong Thien Sinh up to the platform to visit.

Duong Sinh: Please invite your teacher to come with you, otherwise you will be unfamiliar with the situation and people and not dare to handle it alone.

Buddha worship: Okay, let's follow the General to the stage.. First, I stand on the side to observe.

Duong Sinh: Oh! The old man was escorted by the underworld soldiers to the mirror. Why did the old body just now turn into a young man, climbing the wall into someone else's house at night? He stooped to open the window and jumped into the room of an elderly couple while they were sound asleep. The young man who specialized in picking locks and picking at chests was still struggling to find something, when suddenly the husband woke up and shouted in panic. He immediately pulled out a knife and rushed forward to stab his master. Oh! Fresh blood spurted out, I didn't dare look at it.

General: Don't be afraid, this is just an illusion. The Mirror of Evil Karma. When he was a young man, the old man once climbed a wall to steal something from someone's house. When he was discovered, he pulled out a knife and stabbed the homeowner to death. Now we have to go and look at ourselves in front of the Mirror of Evil Karma, so that the images of when we commit crimes will be clearly shown.

Duong Sinh: How is this Mirror of Evil Karma made so magical?

Saying to Buddha: The Mirror reflects Evil Karma, formed by the sacred energy of Heaven and Earth. The souls of criminals come here, their true nature is fully exposed. The truth is that there is nothing magical about it. From childhood to adulthood, people go through a lifetime of negative karma. People have intuition, so what they do, they know clearly. Our spirituality is like a camera, able to record all the actions in the world into the lens, without missing a single thing, so it is the "Mind of Respect". People commit crimes in the dark, outsiders don't know.

But before taking action, if you question yourself and consider carefully before taking action, there must be guidance from "Mind". Therefore, the consciousness silently records all large and small actions. The Khat Kinh Dai in the underworld is made up of two yin and yang energies. When meeting the two energies of a person's soul, the two streams of magic immediately intersect, bringing out all the recorded images of a person's entire life. Therefore, when evildoers come before Nghiet Kinh Dai, their deepest secrets will be revealed and cannot be hidden. The Buddhist scriptures say "All dharmas are born from the mind" (all dharmas are born from the mind) which is also based on this principle.

Duong Sinh: Ah, that's it, but if the soul of a good person comes here, surely Nghiet Kinh Dai will no longer be of any use?

General: The soul of a good person does not need to appear in its original form on Nghiet Kinh Dai. It is written on the Dai Dai "There are no honest people on Nghiet Kinh Dai" but you don't look at it. When good people die, their spirituality is clear in front of Nghiet Kinh Dai, so they only see pure white, like when taking a photo under bright light. Their hearts do not hide darkness, so they cannot see their true form. If the aura of a good person's soul is extremely pure, then the merit must be so great that they will go towards heaven. Or they are assigned directly to the palaces to investigate their merits and mistakes separately, so they don't have to come here. Nghiet Kinh Dai is also called "Karma Kinh", whenever in the mortal world they commit "evil karma" and their true form will immediately appear. Duong Thien Sinh, please try to check again.

Duong Sinh: And the young girl was being escorted by the underworld soldiers to Nghiet Kinh Dai, she was too scared to step forward, she kept screaming miserably, the situation was so pitiful, so heartbreaking. Why don't the soldiers of the underworld pity flowers and pearls, instead using iron forks to push them onto the stage, the treatment is no different from a prisoner... Ah! As for the other place, there were quite a few men going in and out, the house had pink lights and green doors, exactly like the scene in the world used to being called a place for entertainment.

General: It's truly a place for entertainment in the earthly world, please consider carefully.

Duong Sinh: Every room in the house is chirping, it's truly an enchanting place, I don't dare to look at it for long, I'll just go home.

Praying to the Buddha: Looking at it for a long time makes me feel uncomfortable, because I have a heart of "decency, righteousness, honesty, integrity" and am not ashamed to be a satisfied student of the teacher. As for the prostitute, selling souls, selling bodies, deceiving people for money, speaking rudely and harshly, losing all femininity, the offense is too great. Because she had a venereal disease, she died early, so it was difficult for her soul to go to the underworld to escape the tragedy. Advise women in the world to respect and preserve their bodies, absolutely not to indulge in debauchery in a peaceful place, not to sell beauty and fragrance, so that hundreds of thousands of people will kneel on their jade hands and be humiliated by common people. Just because of greed for money, many sins have been created. Men who indulge in debauchery also commit sexual immorality, hoping to quickly correct that bad habit. Duong Sinh! Well, let's get ready to go back to Thanh Hien Hall.

General: Unfortunately you two cannot stay here any longer.

Duong Sinh: Nghiet Kinh Dai understood thoroughly and did not dare to look further. The evil souls have been exposed to all their evil habits, I am still a mortal, and staying here only increases their shame, so I say goodbye.

Buddha Sacrifice: Thank you General for your instructions, we must prepare to return to Thanh Hien Hall, another day will visit the "Bo Kinh Department" (Department of Sutra Supplements), let's go Duong Sinh, quickly get on the lotus, prepare to return to Thanh Hien Hall.

Duong Sinh: I'm so scared!

Buddhist worship: What are you afraid of? Trying to be an honest person will avoid having to come here to reveal your evil face... Having arrived at Thanh Hien Duong, Duong Sinh quickly got down on the lotus platform, his soul entering his body.

THE WORDS HE EIGHTH Preached

We see that, as we practice more and more, our bad nature is revealed, and it is not the Harmful Stage that reveals our bad nature. When you practice the Dharma of Vo Vi Occult Science, you see clearly your bad qualities, jealousy, envy, causing harm to others, all kinds of things in your mind. Only when you meditate do you see, when you meditate you see sin, and the more sin you see, the more blessing you gain. The more you see your sins, the more you refuse and do not commit them again, so this elaborate method shows you, makes you despise you, shows you clearly that you are an unfinished sinful soul, you are the most sinful person in this world. Now we have to repent and practice, focus on progress, then we can untangle ourselves and not need people to praise us. Our actions are for everyone to see, our practice is to open our minds and hearts and develop a sense of harmony in all realms. Therefore, you also have the weapon Namo Amitābha Buddha available to open the consciousness of harmony. The more sociable you are, the more clearly you can see your own mistakes, and the more you suppress and cultivate bad qualities, jealousy, and discrimination against others, the narrower you become. Therefore, Journey to Hell explains very clearly and orderly so that we can understand, learn and practice.Practicing this method makes us realize even more that our madness is from many lifetimes, not just one lifetime. You hope this life will be very easy. In many lifetimes, many lifetimes, you will do evil, you will see clearly in your mind those unjust actions and then they keep committing and re-committing, committing and re-committing, it motivates you, it pushes you back to the old path. Why do you sometimes complain, I practice but I'm still mortal, I'm still chaotic. See?

From your past life, it has been rushing like a tidal wave, it comes to one side of your boat, it hits your boat, and if you are not confident and refuse to go forward, it will sink. When we practice this Zen Dharma, we only go forward and never retreat, never retreat in the face of any adversity. Even if you eat, practice, if you don't eat, practice, practice any means you practice, open the connection with the great nature in Soul Insight, Dharma Wheel, Meditation, harmony with the three worlds, consciousness, correct our sins, live true to yourself and acknowledge your own mistakes, don't justify in your own mistakes and bury your clear mind. So you have the good fortune to get hold of the book Hell's Journey, living in the evil situations that you see before your eyes, hear and see in our society, having done a lot of wrong things, looking back on our actions in the past, we were also very cruel, not gentle, and we are still evil in the present. Eating a lot, sleeping comfortably, dressing beautifully is also evil.But we don't see the Bodhisattva conduct of all living beings saving us, so when we clearly see the Bodhisattva practice of saving all living beings, we pay ten for one, we must do good deeds, don't be deceitful, don't slander others, correct ourselves to evolve in the truth, there is no loss, there is no loss of opportunities to progress to learn the truth and practice in truth, which is to relieve all the troubles and wrongs within the mind. Therefore, you have practiced this Vo Vi method and combined these materials, which are extremely precious. The more you read Hell's Journey, the more profound it becomes. The more you read, the more you understand from the words, from the principle, the original idea, it lies in your mind, not outside. So, on the occasion of my coming here, I take the time to talk with you in our intimate relationship, to work together to learn and to troubleshoot each other. We have sins, we must calmly practice, to untangle each other, to practice, to untangle. We do not dare to despise any religion in the world, we ourselves are sinners, we must practice. A blade of grass is also good and more precious than us. We haven't done anything yet, so we should try to practice.

tieu_de: Chapter 7: Taking a Walk to Supplement the Classics
noi_dung:
Chapter Seven

Teachings on Sutra Sutras

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on the 9th day of the 8th month of the leap year of the Dragon (1976)

Poetry

Dark seven vicense sutras
Monks, nuns and Taoists intertwine in shape
The spirit fluctuates, money and money enjoy
Hell's body soaks in kindness and silence.

Translation

Darkly lit room re-studying the sutras
Monks and nuns are extremely hard on themselves
Bronze bells shake gold coins
Hell clearly hears the situation.

Buddhist worship: Today is about to go to hell, Duong Sinh ascends to the lotus, his mind must not be confused.

Duong Sinh: Yes, but sir, I don't dare look at the tragedy in hell right now.

Buddhist worship: Those sinful souls are guilty, I cannot go back to defend them. Get on the road now..... you've arrived, quickly get down to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Why are those rooms so black and dark, and there seems to be crying inside?

Buddhist worship: That is the “Department of Sutras Supplements” (Department of Supplements to Sutras) I can visit and let you know.

Duong Sinh: Please follow... on the door of the room I saw the three words "Bo Kinh So" written on it, two generals came in from outside, I don't know who they are?

Buddha Sacrifice: This is the General guarding the door.

General: Welcome Buddha Sacrifice and Duong Thien Sinh from Thanh Hien Hall in Taichung.

Buddhist offerings: Without paying any respects, today I will take the holy writer Duong Sinh to visit the Sutra Supplement Department, hoping to receive guidance from the General.

General: Yes, please follow me, you two can enter through the side door, because the big door is only open on the first and full moon days. During these two days, the Department of Sutra Sutras had Buddhas and enlightened Taoist Ancestors coming from the West to teach the Dharma to Taoists, monks and nuns.

Duong Sinh: It is a great honor to come here, but the other doors are not important. The Sutra Sutra Department is gloomy and dark. I stand here and observe enough, there's no need to go inside.

General: Don't be shy, let me lead the way, don't be afraid.

Duong Sinh: That's great, this room is all made of wood, probably too old, so many places are rotten, the walls have holes here and there. In the room were thousands of people dressed as monks, nuns and Taoists. Under the flickering light, they were flipping through scriptures and opening books, chanting loudly, looking very miserable.

Buddhist worship: These monks, nuns and Taoists, while still in the world, specialize in reciting sutras to help people overcome disasters so they can get money to support themselves. But because they lack conscience, they only care about money, so they secretly omit the sutras, do not rely on the books, or recite the wrong words in the sutras. After death, they were banished to the Sutra Supplement Department to re-study the sutras. Every night, they use the light of fireflies to recite the scriptures. If they miss a word, they have to recite it a hundred times, then make up for it and then judge based on that merit.

Duong Sinh: If the General says so, who would dare to recite the Jade Emperor Pho Do Bible and the True Supreme Sutra of the Supreme Sage of the Pure Land of the Holy Sage Duong? There are many people who sincerely chant, but the pronunciation is not correct. Will they be banished to the Department of Sutra Supplements in the future?

General: No, only those who, while still alive, rely on chanting sutras and worshiping as their livelihood, have to go to the Sutra Supplement Department. Taking money from people to help people eliminate disasters, but not chanting enough Buddhist and Holy scriptures, so I had to come here. If you recite sutras for yourself or to serve others, although your dedication is not equal, you do not take advantage of it, do not lie to get money, and if you recite it wrongly, God's law will be especially forgiving.

Duong Sinh: The lamp was dim, as small as a firefly, and was still blown by the wind of the underworld, as if it wanted to go out. Elderly Taoist monks and nuns, with blind eyes, read scriptures in letters as small as the head of a fly. Everyone looked haggard and miserable, truly pitiful.

General: When receiving money, you have to give the goods, but taking money from the owner and not taking care of the other person's affairs properly, of course you will be punished.

Buddhist offerings: Monks, nuns, and Taoists encourage the world by chanting sutras to attain enlightenment. As for those who rely on chanting to earn food, clothing and clothing, they must be very careful. A word or sentence must not be shortened, reduced or recited incorrectly. If we lie and cannot eliminate other people's disasters, we have to bear their disasters.

General: Every day on the first and full moon days, two Buddhist and Taoist leaders come here to control the scriptures and teach them how to pronounce the scriptures correctly. Sentient beings create causes that implicate the Immortals and Buddhas, causing them to personally go to hell to save suffering. Immortals and Buddhas are truly compassionate, all sentient beings must enlighten themselves, because every small action cannot avoid being punished by the laws of the underworld.

Duong Sinh: I have understood clearly, thank you for the General's guidance.

Buddhist worship: Duong Sinh, please come and visit the Taoist to find out why he has to come here?

Duong Sinh: Yes, sir, please tell me why you have to come here?

Taoist: Please don't call me Taoist Chief, because when I was still alive, I was only the Red-Headed Taoist (Red-Headed Taoist) specializing in worshiping and praying to save the dead. But because of my poor education, no basis, memorizing a few scriptures, just reciting along with the sound of bells and gongs, the homeowner did not understand what I was reciting. To waste time, I usually only read one of two pages of the sutra and leave the other one out, just to get money to pocket, and whether the dead can reach the Western Paradise or not is up to them. After my death, I was escorted by the underworld soldiers to the First Palace and then transferred to Bo Kinh So. It's been a year since I came here, two months ago, when I lived, I collected too many sutras and reduced my recitations, so I've had to suffer until now without completing the sutras, and my eyeballs are swollen, red, and in unbearable pain. After completing the supplementation of the scriptures, I may be sent back to the Second Palace to be judged by the judge here because when I was alive I also cast spells to harm people.Right now I'm very regretful, but it's too late. I only hope that my sincere repentance will be conveyed to the magicians and Taoists in the world, to remind them to always act conscientiously, otherwise they will be like me, and now they can only hope for salvation from others.

Duong Sinh: This Taoist monk is so pitiful, please help them escape this suffering.

Buddhist worship: His crime is a crime of retribution, self-inflicted. In this world, he was too happy, causing him to suffer and suffer now. Don't worry about nothing, we are just servants of the afterlife, and also don't worry about interference. This belongs to the laws of the underworld. Time is late, prepare to return to Thanh Hien Hall, thank you General.

Duong Sinh: Thank you, general, the leaders and masters all tried to cultivate again, it's really good.

Buddhist offerings: Quickly go up to the lotus platform... arrived at Thanh Hien Duong, Duong Sinh got down from the lotus platform, his soul entered his body.

HE EIGHT'S WORDS

We read through to see clearly that we are an eternal soul that cannot be hidden, from our every action there is a record that we do it ourselves, no one else does it for us. So we must remember that we must control our own four senses, we should not think wrongly, we should not see wrongly, we must repent when we see wrongly, and we must repent of thinking wrongly, then we will progress quickly. Our mistakes create self-love and then they accumulate. That is the iron door that imprisons us. We have no way out and cannot get out. So what do we practice for? Practicing to open our hearts and minds, opening the prison door of our consciousness, more and more of you who practice, you see that I see that I am ugly, I see that I am guilty towards my husband and children, I see that I am guilty towards my wife and children, I see that I am clearly dictatorial, but before they said I was dictatorial, I was angry. Now I like it, I like it when someone criticizes my dictatorship so I can correct it. I see my bad nature, seeing my bad nature is a great blessing to have the opportunity to correct it, right in the human world during these decades;Then when we go to hell, we won't need to fix it anymore, we will have learned a course of sublimation, becoming lighter, moving forward lighter. So people who only see money as important, see nature as important, see my nature as such is like that. Self-nature is like money, it covers and obscures one's level of progress. I have to find my own nature, I have to discover my own nature, my unjust anger and ignorance, I have to repent, correct it and advance it. That is the responsibility of the soul. That's why today when we practice Zen, many people find it easy and smooth to sit, but some people find it difficult to practice because of their heavy nature, stubbornness, and confusion. Therefore, we practice with the goal of correcting our mind, correcting our nature, and then we can clear our mind and see our nature. Only then can we meditate. So don't be so quick to say: "My father Zhou also imitated soul reflection, Dharma wheel, and meditation, so why can't he?" It's because of my nature that I don't change it.So today you have the opportunity to listen to me reciting Namo Amitābha Buddha so that you can see that this is the motto of self-rule and self-correction, and try to recite the Buddha's name to open up the consciousness of harmony within your inner consciousness. Then you will clearly see that you have to borrow the stick of the Immortals and Buddhas to get there, because you do not have the ability. See? When you recite the Buddha's name, the more you recite the Buddha's name, the more clear your mind is, the more clearly you see your consciousness in harmony and openness, the more you see that the unity of the three worlds is one, the brothers are one, everyone is one. We must no longer harbor bigotry, we must learn to forgive and love. That's it, you can retreat to purity, no longer do you read the purity sutra but your mind doesn't change. You read Buddhist scriptures, understand Buddhist principles, write Buddhist principles, but if your mind is not corrected, how can you progress? It must be fixed, but if you want to fix it, what must you have? If you want to fix it, you have to be touched to fix it. When we encounter it, we see our mistakes, we see our darkness, only then can we build towards the light. That's the fix. So the more you practice, the more light you become, the more you accept it, the more you accept correction, the more you expand.

tieu_de: Chapter 8: Walking around Thac Oan City
noi_dung:
Chapter Eight

DAO Thanh Thac Oan

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on the 16th day of the August leap year of the Dragon (1976)

Poetry

Mid-Autumn Festival, Mid-Autumn Festival, Moon Garden
Souls imprisoned in hell, possessing lobes
Self-searching, short-term vision, difficult to fulfill the wish
The calamity is fierce and eternal.

Translation

How many times to celebrate the full moon and autumn
Hell's souls have no one to love them
Searching for an unsatisfactory death (1)
The winds and winds fly away and cry, the stream of gold flows.(2)

Buddhist worship: This year is a leap year, the second full moon of the Mid-Autumn Festival. From the time I wrote the book Hell Travel to now, a full month has passed. Time is like flowing water, I hope people will be enlightened from their delusions and wake up from their dreams. How many times has the bright moon been full? At what age can we meet again in the leap year, the second full moon of the Mid-Autumn Festival? People stroll around chatting under the moon, there is nothing happy, but when they look back at hell, they only see darkness, ghosts and ghosts crying so pitifully, that no one dares to look. Duong Sinh, prepare to walk to hell.

Duong Sinh: Please obey, time has passed so quickly, it's been a month and not even a tenth of the work of walking through hell to write a book has been completed. I am afraid that this great responsibility will be difficult to achieve.

Praying to Buddha: Just keep your faith, because the ancients said: “The will becomes the essence, the metal and stone are transformed.” (If you have the strength to sharpen iron, you will have success days of success). Your mind is steadfast, the ten gates of hell will open on their own, just take a look and you will understand everything, don't worry too much. Hurry up to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: I have finished preparing, please invite your teacher to depart...

Buddhist worship: I have arrived, quickly get down to the lotus.

Duong Sinh: Is this place "Uong Tu Thanh" (Thac Oan Thanh)? There is a closed gate in front, with three words "Uong Tu Thanh" written on it, should I go inside to visit?

Buddhist worship: Yes, today we are visiting Thac Oan Citadel, please follow me into the citadel.

Duong Sinh: Dear sir, why is the city gate closed tightly, how can I get in?

Buddhist worship: This city gate is an automatic door, like a supermarket door in the world. All unjust souls die because they die in an unnatural and unjust manner, and their injustice is not dissipated.

When the demons of impermanence lead here, the resentments collide and react with each other, this door naturally opens wide. Everything in the underworld is made by the two yin and yang energies of creation. Depending on the mind, we use a Bo fan to fan a fan and the door will naturally open wide.(3)

Duong Sinh: Dear teacher, your skill is very strong. Can you lend me this fan to bring back to the earthly world to perform miracles once for everyone to see?

There were about two thousand people, all of whom looked happy. Guanyin Dai Si sat on a lotus throne, his body covered in white silk, holding a willow branch dipped in nectar from the Tinh Thuy vase. May I ask, what is the intention of such a thing?

Buddhist worship: The rain of Dharma permeates, nectar is sprinkled everywhere, there is a natural predestined to be saved, showing God's compassion, not distinguishing between life, death, and six paths. As long as you are willing to turn around, correct your mistakes, and renew yourself, you will be saved by the boat. That is the great wish of Guan Yin. Don't ask anymore, just listen to the great Guan Yin preach about the Dharma "Save Suffering and Rescue".

Avalokiteśvara: Today, Duong Thien Sinh and Living Buddha Ji Gong of Taichung Sage Hall attended the meeting, I am very happy. I hope that after listening to my sermon, when he returns to earth, Duong Thien Sinh will do his best to dissuade and educate people. In order to popularize the people of the Noble Sage Hall, all the disciples devoted all their efforts, sacrificed everything, created a boat of kindness, saved all sentient beings, their spirit was so beautiful, they will become saints in the future. Please try your best to do it.

Praying to the Buddha: Duong Sinh quickly bowed and thanked the Great Master for his kind advice.

Duong Sinh: Thank you for what Great Master Avalokitesvara teaches. When I return to Thanh Hien Duong, I will pass these teachings on to all my Dharma friends so as not to disappoint the Great Master's trust.

Great Master: Now begins the sermon: "People from beginningless time until now have lived and died and died, but although their physical form is dead, their spirit is immortal. Today you have come to the underworld, but you still have not realized that the illusory body is fake, the wisdom of enlightenment is the truth. Love is difficult to let go, resentment is endless, you must realize that the world is like an illusion, the familiar relationship is achieved by cause and effect, the cyclical retribution is forced one by one. It is impossible to be ignorant and not enlightened. If the thoughts in the head are not extinguished, the worldly nature in the mind will forever be reincarnated. Now when the dharma is overturned, the roots of wisdom are extinguished, and when the child is born intelligent, it will be difficult to keep the flame burning in the wind for a long time, so even if one is intelligent and self-aware, one's wisdom will be obscured, damaging the natural principles and actions Because of the chaos and corruption of the human world, you are the ones who have fallen into a deep grave, your body has been lost, and evil karma follows you, not to mention that there is no light but the shadow does not appear.Every thought and every memory affects the mental organs, and karma immediately binds the body. Now falling into a dark place, there is still a point of conscience left unturned, one must know how to repent for one's mistakes. Now I advise you to come to your senses and try to endure the torture of punishment so that your crimes will disappear. Try to endure the pain, put aside your resentment, I will come to save you." Finished preaching.(3)

Buddhist worship: Quickly send him away.

Duong Sinh: Obey the command. Thank you for the golden words of the Great Avalokiteśvara... All the ghosts and ghosts knelt down and bowed far away. Many people after hearing this were moved and cried.

Buddhist worship: The Great Being pitied the ghosts and spirits, gave golden words of advice and comfort, and indeed developed Bodhicitta, hoping that all sentient beings would devote themselves to enlightenment. If there were still people who regretted their lives and did not cultivate the Way early, when they died, they would go to hell and then practice again, it would be much more difficult for Duong Sinh to return to the Sage Hall class="book-paragraph">General: If there is anything disrespectful in this palace, please forgive Buddha and Duong Thien Sinh

Duong Sinh: Here, I am a mortal, why would I ask for "forgiveness" which is so condescending. I would like to ask again, Master, are all the halls in hell set up as preaching places? Finally, when will the sinful soul be free from sin and become enlightened?

Buddhist worship: The teaching stations set up by the temples are the lowest level, mainly to test the disposition of sinful souls to see if their enlightenment is shallow or deep. After that, there are also higher level teaching stations for them to re-cultivate. Don't ask anymore, it's already late, quickly get on the lotus, prepare to return to Thanh Hien

Dang, thank you for the General's hospitality... Having arrived at Thanh Hien Duong, Duong Sinh quickly got down on the lotus, his soul entering his body.

WHAT HE TEACHES

(1) The Sun is evolving every day.

(2) See clearly? I said: Oh my father, I work here. Hell doesn't know, the King of Hell is nowhere to be seen, you're in trouble, you're nowhere to be seen. I did something wrong, you don't have to steal other people's things to do something wrong. It's wrong for you to be angry with someone, just a little bit of anger is wrong. How to cultivate a single mind that is impure. Always be in the state of the ten thousand spirits, blend in the state of the ten thousand spirits to open ourselves and save people. That is what we need, that is proof of inner liberation.

(3) There, Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara also said it all clearly, those who are not awake, in the world, practice without being awake, will die and become ghosts, but who practice consciousness will never go to hell but embrace the karma of resentment and become a demon. Therefore, Avalokiteśvara also warned and clearly stated that we must practice it to have consciousness, to know that our soul is immortal. If we do not practice it to consciousness, we will never know that our soul is immortal. Knowing that our soul is immortal, we will not do wrong things that will result in us being punished in the future. That's it, so when we understand clearly... we practice and understand clearly that when we come out of the soul we have a soul, the soul is immortal, but what is the soul? It is a structure because the supernatural is typical and not impure, so if we look straight up, we can hear the words of the Great Master and show us that karma cannot be nurtured in the mind. That cruel, dark anger and ignorance is karma and must be abandoned quickly.

GENERAL LECTURES Now I have the opportunity to listen again to the words of the Great Man of Avalokiteśvara, all of which are thorough in spiritual salvation, without abandoning anyone. One sentence of His is to comprehend the three realms. So we practice, we make the Falun Always Turn, for what purpose? To understand the three realms within our internal organs, within that organ, we can contact the three realms of Heaven and Earth. When we are clear, we can read any sutra and our mind will be opened, our mind will be pure, the more we practice, the more the Zen will develop on the head, then your consciousness will no longer be nourished in the mind of flesh, no longer nourished in the mind of the flesh, but right in the heart of the head in the middle here, in the void, that feeling is the true mind. Sitting here but not here, studying the Dharma continuously 24/7.Therefore, people who make the effort to practice to that level are easy to forgive and easy to build. Even if demons come to harm us, we can still transform them, use our pure compassion and hard work to save them, then we see that all brothers and sisters in the same family in the universe no longer have demons towards us, if we have good intentions and good will to practice. Returning to NO is returning to BUDDHA, but achieving that truth is to open the consciousness of harmony. So you diligently recite Buddha's name in the beginning, then later on, recite often, without separate thoughts, there is no need to recite anymore. I thought it had to be, it was so gentle. There comes a time when you don't need to recite but are mindful, because the aura has been constantly developing and it is expanding more and more, but it is no longer narrow. Our minds see that what belongs to God and Buddha no one can take away. No one can hold this thing and run across the globe. No one can rob us and we have to be afraid.We are only afraid that if we lose our mind and insight, we will be robbed of our true mind by the devil of impermanence, so our temper will be unstable towards our family, we will commit bad crimes, we will plunge ourselves into hell without knowing it, we will claim to be a poor cultivator, and the world will suffer countless losses! After practicing, have you verified that what I said is true? You only need to practice to save yourself, but if you want to practice a lot, you have to use a lot of resentment as kindness, and you need a lot of touching. We are happy and thanks to that, we can see our courage. If we had smooth sailing, how could we know the Way? Why are enlightened people only successful in patience? What makes Him patient? The treachery and excitement caused Him to be patient and let his consciousness evolve and often save others, attacking us and if we are Great Compassion, we will save. So God was cursed but God saved, Buddha was cursed but Buddha saved, see clearly!We follow that example and follow that example. If we become human, don't be afraid that you won't have a job. If you resolve your mind's karma, your saving consciousness will constantly work in the three realms, returning to purity clearly, not talking with your lips, returning to purity but not being pure. When you tell me to retreat to peace, you will be more agitated, and if you can't stand it during the excitement, you will fail, try it on the spot. There are many times when meditating friends see me lighten up, feeling very happy then it becomes heavy, impermanent ghosts do one thing and it becomes heavy immediately. When your internal desire is moved, it immediately becomes worse, see clearly? The scene of going to hell in the blink of an eye, not having to wait for the devil to catch me before going to hell. In the blink of an eye, you will fall down, during meditation you will also fall down, but each task is clearly outlined so you have to understand that place.

tieu_de: Chapter 11: Walking through Hell, Mud, Feces, and Urine
noi_dung:
Episode Eleven

WALKING IN HELL URINE-FECTURED MUD

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on the 3rd day of the 9th month, year of the Dragon (1976)

Poetry

Still hand session to open the book of Diep Thu
The mind is uncontrolled and afraid of falling in the river like
The mortal body is infected with lotus flowers
The immortals and Buddhas of the heavens follow birth and death.

Translation

With clean hands, turn the leaf of the sutra
The mind is not bound by suffering from oneself
The wise rose bush is dyed with white lotus
Following in the footsteps of the Buddha and Immortal to overcome life and death.

Buddhist worship: Birth and death is a big matter for humans, so it is difficult to avoid the two words death and birth, so Trang Tu said "The ego does not wish to be born, suddenly it is born like that. The ego does not wish to die, suddenly dies without the will" (I originally did not want to be born, suddenly born was born. I originally did not want to die, suddenly the limit of death came). Even though we know that humans cannot control life and death, we cannot say that humans have no way to control life and death. Just because people don't understand the way life, death, and birth come from? Where do you go when you die? He must have been confused and not clear,

that's why he let the King of Hell take control, so he said: "The King of Hell is determined to stay in the three realms of death, difficult to flow and operate until the five seasons of heaven." (King of Hell has decided to die in the third watch, it is difficult for him to live until the fifth watch). Now, at the time of universal salvation, if people in the world understand and return to the truth, or follow the great path, cultivate their minds and nurture their nature, they will naturally be reborn and avoid death, and will not return to reincarnation. People should cherish the body they were born in and live in the middle of the earth. At this moment, it is not too late to become enlightened and practice. Duong Sinh prepares to walk to hell.

Duong Sinh: Yes, my teacher spared no effort, he diligently and earnestly taught people, making people feel very touched right now.

Holy worship to Buddha: My responsibility is that Immortals and Buddhas use compassion to save people and save lives as their duty, quickly ascend to the lotus throne.

Duong Sinh: I'm ready, please depart...

Buddhist worship: We have arrived at the second temple, quickly get down to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Why did you come to this place tonight?

Buddhist worship: First pay homage to the King of Hell, then visit the prisons again.

Duong Sinh: The King of Hell has moved his palace, he must come quickly... To pay his respects to the King of Hell and the Immortals.

King of Hell: No formalities, quickly stand up and invite Te Buddha and Duong Thien Sinh to go inside the palace to rest.

Buddhist worship: Because time is limited, I don't find it necessary, just taking Duong Thien Sinh to visit prison to be punished is enough.

King of Pluto: Okay. General, please guide Te Phat and Duong Thien Sinh to visit the prison.

General: Please obey my orders. Please follow me.

Duong Sinh: Oh, the smell of this place is so hard to smell, it seems to be the stench of feces and urine.

General: Ahead is the “Phan Nhieu Ne Hell” (Hell urine and feces mud) so this place stinks, please forgive me.

Duong Sinh: The more I go, the stronger the smell becomes, the more difficult it is to breathe, teacher, I can't stand it anymore, I don't want to go anymore.

Buddhist offerings: Don't be afraid, I have this treasure, take it.

Duong Sinh: What is this object?

Buddhist worship: Put on the dust filter, the air is naturally clean, all foul smells will disappear.

Duong Sinh: It's so good, I can't smell anything anymore. Ah, there was a wooden sign hanging in front, with the word Hell of Mud, Feces, and Urine on it. The sound of wailing was coming from inside. Looking at it, you see a person's head bobbing, his hands moving around, as if he were swimming.

General: This is the Mud, Feces and Urine Hell, come closer and see.

Duong Sinh: Okay, okay. Dear teacher, don't you smell the stench?

Praying to the Buddha: There is no taste, I have become a Buddha, this unclean thing, I can see it as well as not see it, its smell does not penetrate my sense of smell, I am different from you as a mortal, whenever you see sound and color, you are touched and fascinated.

Duong Sinh: This large pond is like a wide ocean, with no berth but no shore. In the pond there were both young and old, men and women, they swam and swam with feces and urine. Every time I open my mouth to scream, I swallow more feces and urine. It's so dirty! Teacher! I want to vomit!

Praying to Buddha: Be steadfast in your mind, don't let unclean smells affect your mind.

Duong Sinh: I really don't understand, may I ask General, what crime did those who came here commit to make them suffer this torture?

General: They are prostitutes, during their lives they specialize in selling their bodies for money, seducing daughters from good families to sell to customers to break their virginity, and pawning them at high interest rates. Eat each other to gain fat. His feet are not dirty, he only uses his cunning tongue to deceive others out of money. The one who indulges in excessive lust, the one who bears false witness, speaks black and white. People pretend to invite others to play and then take advantage of them, cooperate in business and then take capital. An official who takes bribes. The middleman takes profits. The person in charge of building a house takes a cut of wages and materials. Those who were impure and poisoned in life and whose mouth and mouth were not clean will be banished to this prison when they die so they can taste the stench. The souls here are in great pain, their breath smells of feces and urine, every time they open their mouths something unclean flows in, their stomachs are both hungry and thirsty, and when they want to eat there is nothing to eat. Those who, while alive, eat only dirty food to survive, and when they die, go to hell to receive such retribution, are worthy of it. Therefore, in the mud of feces and urine, the more they struggled to escape, the deeper they sank.(1)

Duong Sinh: It's so pitiful, nowadays Yang has used mechanical toilets, which completely eliminate the stench, along with chemicals to eliminate toxins, rich people also use scented oils to kill the stench. But they are greedy and impure with money, their bodies look beautiful on the outside but their hearts smell of dirty shit, so it is reasonable to be banished to this prison.

Buddhist worship: Duong Sinh is right, every family is rich and beautiful, and wears splendid clothes. On the outside, it looks clean and tidy, but in reality, the mind inside contains thousands of plans. It's like speculation and hoarding, without any pursuit of righteousness, which can be said to be exactly like the taste and appearance of feces and urine. While living, although you enjoy the moment, when you go to hell, things are very different, because you can only eat dirty food to get through the day.

General: Can't agree with them, those guys are all pitiful insects, like beetles, specializing in eating dirty things to grow. Advise people to be fair and righteous, not to see money and use tricks and deceit to harm people. Those who specialize in dishonest professions to earn dirty money will certainly have to come here to pay their debts after death.

Duong Sinh: I wonder when these sinful souls will end their suffering?

General: Judgment depends on whether their crime is serious or light, but at least until the criminal's flesh is crushed. When he finishes his sentence here, he will be transferred to another prison to be tried for the remaining crimes.

Duong Sinh: Hell today is so scary.

Buddhist worship: The time is getting late, today I feel the journey here is enough. Duong Sinh prepares to return to Thanh Hien Duong. Thank you, General, for your guidance. Also thanks to the General on behalf of the King of Hell for taking care of him.

Duong Sinh: Do I have to take down the cage I'm wearing?

Holy offerings to Buddha: Go up to the lotus and then remove it, otherwise you won't be able to stand it.

Duong Sinh: Dear, I have ascended to the lotus platform.

Buddha Sacrifice: You can take it down and start returning to the Sage Hall. The wind of the underworld is cold, the filth is thick, the rose bushes are thousands of feet tall, burying so many good heroes.

Advising people to quickly reform themselves to escape the hell of sadness... Arriving at Thanh Hien Duong, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus, his soul entering his body.

THE WORDS HE EIGHTH Preached

(1) So we see that the deceitfulness of people in the world is impossible to avoid, avoid the law here, but our souls are already polluted. As the day gets worse, what will happen when you die? When we die, we have to be in that heavy realm, so we are forced to live in that situation. Because if you rely on cunning to support yourself, then once you get used to the dirt and mud, that's where you'll run. So you practice this Vo Vi method, every day, every day, every purification, every breath of pure air. In the past, when you breathed in the air, it was difficult for the Falun to turn regularly, but today when you breathe, if an unclean thing passes in front of you, you breathe in and see that it is heavy, and when you pull it out, you see it. It gets lighter and lighter, and then it settles on the head, we see that there is no delusion, no attachment, it's the same everywhere. So now, you will also have the opportunity to go down to visit these prisons, if you practice lightly you will go there...Then you think why they eat year after year but they don't die, their soul is still there, then try eating, after eating you still get nothing, but you learn to be patient and let your mind be conscious so you have a chance to be liberated. So as we practice, the more we touch each other, the more we realize that I need more consciousness, I need more liberation, I feel that my body is impure, I am living in the urine-stained mud that is this body. If you eat more than three inches of tongue, your tongue will stink, it's not clean. So we are living in it, not because we are not there but we are afraid. The more we practice the Dharma wheel, the more purified it becomes, from impurity it turns to purity, it turns your saliva sweet. The nectar juice is sprinkled with fresh dharma water. The water of the Dharma has permeated your consciousness, and above your head the light shines brightly while you close your eyes in purity. Even if you no longer pay attention to your breath, there is no bad smell. Going there is the beginning of enlightenment and study of the Way. At that time we see that the scriptures are extremely precious. Any religion in the world, a sutra is an extremely elaborate effort to guide sentient beings.Living beings make mistakes, and nurture impurities, forget purity, and nurture purity to evolve.

GENERAL LECTURES So what can be used to prove impurity? Right now, when we practice, everyone tries to practice, tries to make the Dharma Wheel Always Turn and feel light, likes clean places, likes to look at clear, open places, likes to listen to words of super enlightenment, but when we go to work in the world, when we sit and talk, we feel light, when we meet a person who comes directly to us, we feel heavy in our chest, the His head is throbbing, I see the other person, the other person is a load of impurities, he is no different from urine mud, his mind is thinking about destructive and unhealthy things. That's why those who practice Vo Vi gradually... gradually become lighter, understand the other person, sit face to face with each other, understand, measure, see that it is heavy in the chest, what do we do now? We recite Namo Amitābha Buddha's name to save others and increase our level of clear light. From our own light, we guide the other person. We pray for the other person to soon be freed from the yoke of impurity within their hearts.

tieu_de: Chapter 12: Walking in Hell of Hunger and Thirst
noi_dung:
Chapter Twelve

WALKING IN HELL WITH HUNGER

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas on the 9th day of the 9th month, year of the Dragon (1976)

Poetry

The most noble song of the song "Vong Xuan Phong"
Nuu beach love is the main source of love
The hidden world of civilization
The soul is doomed to fall into the net.

Translation

Spring has come, waiting for the wind, singing songs
Bending back, arms and legs, stepping on the ground
Advancing the dark ways of life
The black soul falls into the net set by Heaven.

Praying to Buddha: We have to work hard to write books, because who is suffering, because who is troubled? Although the streets of this world are bustling with traffic, morals are declining and customs are becoming more and more depraved. The cries of the unjust souls in the underworld shook the mountains of hell. Thanh Hien Duong ordered the Jade Emperor to write the book Journey to Hell. Describing the punishments and tragedies in hell is intended to use those scenes to explain the truth so that people can clearly see their delusions, so this book is not an entertaining novel. I hope people understand that clearly. Duong Sinh prepares to go to hell.

Duong Sinh: I have finished preparing, please depart.

Praying to the Buddha: It is a privilege for mortals to sit on the lotus throne, so Duong Sinh must cherish this reward..... It's here, quickly get down from the lotus. Today I visited a hungry and thirsty prison.

Duong Sinh: This place is like a desert, all four sides are deserted, which direction should we go?

Buddhist worship: Not far from here, after passing this bumpy road, you will reach the Hell of Hunger and Thirst.

Duong Sinh: If there is no human shadow, which way will the ghost go to enter the prison?

Buddhist worship: If you look to the left, the reason must be clear.

Duong Sinh: Ah! Sure enough, I saw a small road on the left side, with two or three ghosts with buffalo heads and horse faces escorting away souls.

Buddhist worship: Let's go to the right to go with them.

Nuu General: In what country do mortals come here on their own?

Buddhist worship: Open your eyes and look closely, it's not too late.

Duong Sinh: This buffalo-headed General is ugly and scary, holding an iron pitchfork and iron blade, looking very ferocious. I don't understand if you intend to do evil to me?

Buddha: Don't be afraid, I will tell him clearly.

Nuu General:Who are you two? Speak quickly, otherwise I will tie you up and hand you over to the Lord to judge.

Buddhist worship: General, how long have you been a soldier of the underworld, why don't you know me?

General Niu: I have only been in charge of the underworld for just over two months. I must carry out the above order. Anyone without a permit will be arrested. That is my responsibility.

Buddha Sacrifice: I am the Living Buddha Te Gong, and this person is a disciple of Quan Thanh De Quan of the Taichung Holy Sage Hall in the earthly world, serving as a guide to hell and writing books of life advice. Today, I wanted to go to the Hunger Prison but I could only get this far. The General must know that we have Ngoc Chi at our disposal, do not stop us, disobey our orders and you will be punished.

Nuu General: Ngoc Chi in front of me, please bow in greeting. It turned out that people in the world originally called him the crazy monk Te Cong. I also left this world not long ago, and have never met the Great Buddha. I ask for forgiveness from you and Thien Sinh. If you want to go to the Prison of Hunger and Thirst, you can go over that small hill. I'll take you two there.

Buddhist worship: That's great. Duong Sinh, let's follow General Quan and go there.

Duong Sinh: Very good. This small road is full of rubble, the road surface has many potholes and is flooded, walking is really miserable, the soles of your feet ache like needles. In front were two more Generals, they were escorting a woman, looking at her jewelry, she seemed very rich, but her feet were chained. What crime did she come here for?

Buddhist worship: The rich people in this world enjoy too much, do not care about grain, freely throw away food, eat too much and eat too much, so they are escorted to this Hell of Hunger to have a chance to live and understand the suffering of hunger and thirst.

Duong Sinh: This hill is not high, the trees are lush, full of reeds and vines, exactly like the hills in the earthly world, on the hill there is only a small road, just enough for three people to pass.

Buddhist worship: After passing this hill, you look ahead and will see the Hunger and Thirst Prison set up at the foot of the hill.

Duong Sinh: I see, the prison walls on all four sides are made of hard cast iron, painted black, with latches, and have reached the foot of the hill.

General Niu: Please wait here for a moment, I will report first.

Duong Sinh: The four words Hell of Hunger and Thirst are carved deeply into the wooden board and do not look very clear, on both sides there are soldiers and generals closely guarding it. The escorting woman who went ahead was led into prison.

General: I have gone inside to report to the prison warden. Please follow me.

Prisoner: Welcome the Living Buddha Ji Cong with

Duong Thien Sinh of Thanh Hien Duong condescended to visit. It's too rude to come out late, please forgive me.

Buddhist worship: It's okay, we're here to bother you, because the Holy Sage Duong only wrote the book Hell's Journey, I led Duong Sinh's soul to the underworld to clearly observe the situation, then write it into a document to warn people. Come here today, I hope Nguu Quan will give you many instructions.

Jail: The prison is the Hunger Prison under the Second Palace, I guided Duong Thien Sinh to visit. Please stay here to drink tea and rest.

Duong Sinh: Good, I followed the Prison Officer to... this prison, each room is as big as three mats, the people imprisoned in there, although they are wearing beautiful clothes, why are their faces yellow and weak, their mouths constantly complaining?

Jail: Those people were all businessmen in the world, dressed in excess, threw away money like trash, did not know how to be frugal, had no mercy towards the poor or beggars, and after death they were all banished to this prison. I called a male sinner to come here so you can interrogate them.

Duong Sinh: Please sir, why do you have to come here to suffer?

Nam Sin Hon: When I was born, I opened a factory to do business, and the business prospered, making a lot of profit. Because of the business relationship, we have to attend social events every day, at restaurants, hotels, and high-rises, spending tens of thousands of dong on each party without regretting it, but the welfare of the employees is extremely harsh, so the workers often resent it. If there were charity organizations asking for help, I would have only given about 500 VND, which is really lacking in kindness. It's like when a beggar or a poor relative comes to borrow money and sends a servant to lie and say he's away. At home, they eat lavish meals and delicious seafood without being frugal. Outside, they keep many lovers and build golden houses to house beautiful women, spending tens of thousands of dong each month. Two years ago, he died of high blood pressure and was sentenced to the Prison of Hunger. Although he wore a suit, he had no food to eat. He could only get a bowl of vegetables and a bowl of porridge instead of rice every week. After three days he was starving and comatose.The underworld soldier with the head of a buffalo and the face of a horse poured water to wake him up. It was extremely painful. His stomach was hungry and his intestines were cramping unbearably. You have food, please give me a little, I'm very hungry.(1)

Jail Officer: You beasts, come here quickly, don't make a fuss, you're on your own, enjoying too much, don't cry. Then call out the guilty woman and quickly declare the crimes you committed on earth for Duong Thien Sinh to hear.

Female Sinner: When I was alive, I was the wife of a rich man. Because my husband opened a business factory, specializing in building houses, I went from a small house to a big house. Because he had a lot of money, he became more and more dishonest, learned to play cards, indulged in gambling day and night, forgetting all family responsibilities. Often meeting friends to go to discos, or eating and drinking all night, a life of wasteful gambling and gambling, never saving money. When it comes to helping the poor or charity work, it is neglected and ignored. I enjoyed it all my life, but after I died, the king of hell didn't pity me and sent me to this prison to suffer. Now I'm hungry and thirsty and I can't stand it.

Duong Sinh: This sinful woman, her face clearly showing pain, put her fingers in her mouth and chewed, as if she was too hungry and thirsty to bear.

Jail Officer: Quickly go to prison.

Duong Sinh: I hope the Prison Officer will make it clear, I see guilty souls in the prisons, regardless of whether men or women wear beautiful clothes, why are they like beggars on the side of the road, moaning incessantly, their hair disheveled, chewing their fingers to relieve hunger?

Jail: All people who destroy God's will, do not spare grain, spend wastefully and do not know how to save. If you have money, you only worry about spending it for your own enjoyment, not giving alms to the poor or doing public works. Men with money neglect their wives and children, and set up love groups outside to live with concubines and mistresses. Or women who soon become famous, like today's singers, consider their husbands worthless, arbitrarily divorce, and enjoy fake fame like this and that. When people become rich, they change their minds and give birth to many despicable acts. Practice for what? Practice to restore balance and to feel the grace of God and Buddha that has nurtured us. Everyone of us sitting here is guilty of not knowing, not being clear, not understanding, and doing wrong in the past; and now we repent so that we can see our sin. Not saying - that guy is guilty, I'm not guilty. Everyone is guilty. Therefore, you must try to persevere and persevere in your life as a human being, which is very precious. Today, we are allowed to be perfect human beings, to listen to the sages, to search for the truth to learn the right path and walk on our own. So today, when we turn to goodness to find peace in our inner consciousness, we must be patient day after day, year after year, month after month, but in the blink of an eye we see gray hair and blurry eyes. When I get older, where will I go? At this moment, the person I am has not repented, I have not returned to my own essence.I still don't see clearly my crime and I repent and repent so that I can sacrifice the bad habits that I embrace every day in my inner consciousness. I let it go. I leave it. When I returned to the good enlightenment above, I eventually found a clear liberation for myself. That's why each person cultivates himself or herself. It is a miracle and there is no divine Immortal or Buddha to help me. God and Buddha also have complete intelligence, but if you do not use the ultimate power to correct yourself in the evolutionary cycle of forgiveness and love, you will always be stuck and unable to open your intelligence. Many people say that if I have this talisman, I will be fine. Many people said that if I had this monk, I would be fine. Saliva surges, ocean waves
Harm people who dance with their tongues to exaggerate

Today, preparing to visit the underworld, Duong Sinh quickly climbed up to the lotus platform.

Sinful Soul: The pain in my mouth is unbearable, besides, I have already told the King of Hell clearly before, why are you forcing me to tell you now?

Sinful Soul: Because the monk is the Living Buddha Ji Gong, when I was still alive, I had heard your great name. It is so worthy of death. Please forgive me. The Living Buddha will forgive me. Next, I would like to recount my evil karma while still alive. When I was still in this world, because I had a natural voice and a talent for singing, I often went to restaurants and theaters to perform, and was also invited by pharmacies to sing to advertise their businesses and businesses. In the singing world, in order to satisfy the vile tastes of the audience, I often performed lewd songs that I composed myself, or performed sexually provocative movements, and the audience below applauded loudly. After my death, the King of Hell was sentenced to death. He thought that in my entire life I had not sung a patriotic song, a song that would cheer up people's hearts to educate humanity, but were filled with songs that corrupted customs, were low-class, and were harmful to society and customs. So he sentenced me to exile for ten years in Throat Stabbing Prison. Every day, I was stabbed in the mouth with an iron rod. It was true that I had a mouth but couldn't speak.While living a life of debauchery and many other crimes, after completing my exile here, I must continue to be exiled to another prison, according to what the Prison Officer told me. Otherwise, after death, the tongue will enjoy songs that taste bitter and painful.

Jail: Reminds the singers in the world to sing songs that uplift people's hearts, not to sing sentimental love songs that soften the hearts of young men and women, but to sing healthy songs to cheer up the youth. Sin Soul: My mouth hurts so much, it's still bleeding. Thinking back to when I was alive, because of my extroverted personality, after getting married, I often fought with my husband, opened my mouth to curse Heaven and blame the Earth, and often fought with neighbor women. Usually, I often say bad things about others, causing discord in their families. There was a neighbor with whom I often quarreled. I also often destroy other people's karma. In addition, I often say yes or no, or no success or yes too much. After his death, the King of Hell was sentenced to eight years in Throat Throat Prison. In addition, there are other crimes, I do not dare to declare more.

Jail Officer: That's right, your evil mouth has created too much karma.

Buddhist worship: Time is short, I have to prepare to return to Thanh Hien Duong, do Duong Sinh have any more questions?

Duong Sinh: I would like to interview another criminal about his illegal behavior when he was young.

Jail Officer: Quickly declare the crimes you committed while you were alive to Duong Sinh.

Sin Soul: When I was still in this world, because my father knew how to make medicine and use herbs to treat people's illnesses. I often watch my father dispense medicine for patients, so I also know a little about medicine. After my father passed away, the illness

After my death, the King of Hell would banish me to this prison to suffer my crime. Now it's too late to regret it.

You must also not lie that bad medicine is good medicine, otherwise your tongue will create verbal karma and you will be banished to this Throat Throat Prison.

Duong Sinh: Many thanks to the Prison Officer for his careful instruction and warm hospitality.

Jail Officer: Goodbye to both of you. If you have anything else you want to clarify in the future, please feel free to visit.

Duong Sinh: I'm ready, I invite you to depart.

Praying to Buddha: Anyone who likes to lie and put things behind other people's backs, women who are not gentle and gentle in temperament, destroy people's marriages and family happiness, and are rude even to elders must change their behavior, otherwise after death they will be banished to Throat Throat Prison. Therefore, if you know how to repent, disasters will disappear and blessings will come.

Arrived at Thanh Hien Hall. Duong Sinh got down on the lotus platform and his soul entered his body.

noi_dung:
Chapter Twenty-Six

WALKING IN HELL CUTTING TENDONS AND CUTTING BONES

Living Buddha Te Gong Christmas February 16, Year of the Tiger (1977)

Poetry

Greatly exploiting profits, good business
The co-operate in the field, hundreds of industries become successful

Happiness and carelessness discuss business acquisition.

Eager to open a market to do business
Old and young participate in many arts and crafts
All hands turn over the Thien Ly cards
Greed for money, don't talk about fame.

Buddhist worship: Today it's time to walk to hell, Duong Sinh quickly go to the lotus.

Duong Sinh: Obeying orders, I am ready, please depart.
