Duong Sinh: In front of us is the Prison of Cutting Tendons and Chopping Bones, clearly written on the prison door. The Prison Officer and the General also came to the door to welcome us. Please bow your head to present yourself to the Prison Officer and the Generals. The disciple Duong Sinh followed Buddhist monk Te Cong to the prison for an interview. Hope to be of much help.

Buddhist worship: Today I will guide Duong Sinh to visit the prison to write a book. Nowadays, the world is going crazy, only praising material things but not cultivating the spirit, being greedy for profit and not leaving any tricks behind, the only thing is to have a lot of money. So where is the conscience God gave to the world? So I just find it sad to say "Conscience is not equal to money"! Nhan Thanh Hien Duong in Taichung, Southern Shaan Bo Chau, only promotes religion to win back the hearts of fallen people through writing books to advise people, and his career in the world is truly brilliant. Therefore, the Jade Emperor gave a reward and a special decree to write the book Hell's Journey, so Duong Sinh was guided by me to visit the underworld and then write the situation in the prisons into the book so that people can understand clearly. Today, when I come to the prison, I hope to receive detailed instructions.

Prison Officer: Sacrifice Buddha is very correct. The two of you worked hard to carry out the order to write the book. We also received a telegram informing you in advance, everything was clear. I invite you both to follow me inside to visit.

Duong Sinh: Good ghosts are very cruel. They used sharp knives to cut off both of the criminals' hands, making everyone scream and cry, but because their bodies were tied tightly to the cross-shaped post, there was no way to escape.

Jail: This prison is the Bone-Cutting Tendon-Cutting Prison. Demon soldiers use sharp knives to cut off all the sinew's hand tendons, and throw the flesh to the iron dogs to eat. Finally, they cut off the hand bones. The sufferer is extremely painful.

Duong Sinh: I saw the punished souls all unconscious, on the other side there were many black dogs calmly sitting and chewing on the sinner's arms. In the real world, dogs only lie under the table, gnawing on fish bones, chickens, pigs, etc. thrown by their owners. As for dogs that eat human flesh to survive, we have never seen them. I would like to ask the Prison Officer, where do those black dogs come from?

Jail: That dog is called "iron dog", every prison in the underworld has it, specializing in eating human flesh to survive. Because it has no humanity, it is called "iron dog". If a dog in the positive world has a very wise spirit, he knows how to keep his house and is loyal to his owner. Nowadays, people still raise precious dogs that are extremely smart, live almost like humans, and even sleep with their owners. But with dogs in hell, things are very different. To punish people who no longer have humanity and are so confused that they lose all goodness, that's why the underworld has to raise iron dogs to eat human flesh. That is the reason for retribution, so saying "a dog's heart" means just this type.

Duong Sinh: Ngu Quan is right, a person without loyalty cannot be compared to a dog. Looking at these guilty souls, I see that they have suffered such pitiful punishments. I wonder what crime they have committed?

Buddhist offerings: Let me use a fan to awaken the guilty soul, clearly recount the crimes committed, watch me perform magic.

Duong Sinh: Sure enough, all the guilty souls were awake and their bodies were restored.

Jail Officer: I temporarily release three guilty souls so that they can confess to Duong Sinh and write it in Hell's Journey. Order this guilty soul to quickly confess all the crimes committed while on earth that caused him to be exiled here after death.

Sinful Soul: I declare, declare. It hurts so much! My children and grandchildren in the earthly world do not know that I am suffering to this extent in the underworld, but think that after death, people end. When I was still alive, I worked as a tea seller. Because I wanted to make a lot of profit, I thought of a way to cheat. Like a pound of dry tea is sixteen taels, but I only weigh fourteen taels. Throughout your life, you cheat and lose, although you often hear people say you need to be honest in business. If you cheat by half a kilogram in this life, you will have to pay eight taels in the next life. But I didn't listen, I didn't have any conscience. Who would have thought that after death, the soul went to the underworld, before the mirror to reflect on bad karma, all the evil sins of life appeared clearly, and was sentenced to ten years in this Prison of Cutting Tendons and Chopping Bones by the Four Palaces of Minh Vuong. Every day I was taken out to have my tendons and flesh cut off, and the devil ripped my hands off like a real person cutting a fish. It's too late to repent. Those who do business in this world must be very honest, don't be greedy for small profits, or cheat in measurement. The punishment in hell is very harsh, it cannot be avoided. Vuong Minh hates these types of people very much, so he is very careful, the devil is too cruel. It's too late to regret now.

Prisoner: Who told you to cheat? Now that I'm in hell, I'll be punished by the devil so that I don't dare to do anything wrong again. Order the second guilty soul to quickly come forward and clarify his unjust actions while still on earth so that Duong Thien Sinh in Thanh Hien Duong on earth can clearly understand.

Sinful Soul: Obeying orders. When he was alive, because his family was poor, he couldn't get an education, so he worked as a scrap dealer to make a living. Every day, I ride my three-wheeled bicycle everywhere to buy waste products such as waste paper, scrap metal, torn clothes, shoes, etc. Because I heard a colleague say that if you buy waste copper and iron and weigh it correctly, it won't make much profit. You have to weigh it wrongly to get a lot of profit. I did so. The seller standing outside still saw that I had weighed correctly. In fact, I was tricked without even realizing it. The items that should have weighed ten pounds, I only weighed seven, the second-hand seller didn't know because the sale was good. All my life I have tried to cheat and gain countless profits. After his death, the King of Hell was so angry that he scolded me for buying used goods for fraud and damaging my virtue. Currently imprisoned in this prison for fifteen years. Every day he was brought to justice, despised and scolded by the evil soldiers, and was so miserable that he could not speak. I hope Thien Sinh will pity me and please reduce my punishment so that I can soon escape my suffering. Thank you, thank you.

Duong Sinh: Dear teacher! This guilty soul confessed very honestly, thinking the situation was pitiful, his clothes were torn, I wanted to help them a little.

Praying to Buddha: We only serve to write books, we should not interfere in other people's affairs, let the Prison Officer handle things more conveniently.

Prisoner: When you live with unclean hands, now you should let the devil peel off your skin and carve your flesh, chop your bones, and cut your tendons. Isn't that the carefulness of every pound? If your tendons still hurt, you're not a man. A guilty man must have the courage to endure it, not beg. Call on the third guilty soul to quickly reveal the story of his unvirtuous behavior while still alive to Thien Sinh so that he can write it in the book Hell's Journey to warn against corrupt gamblers in the world.

Sinful Soul: When he was still alive, my husband was a middle-class civil servant. When he went to work and the children went to school, they saw me alone at home with free time, and the ladies in the neighborhood invited me to play mahjong. At first I didn't know, so they taught me. Gradually, not only could I play mahjong, but I also knew how to play all kinds of cards. Although losing at mahjong was not much, since I became addicted to gambling, I neglected my husband and children and wandered around casinos. My husband begged me to dissuade me, but I ignored him, so there was often turmoil in the family. Four years ago, he had a heart attack and died. When he arrived in hell, the King of Hell sentenced him to exile in this prison, with half a year left before his sentence expired. I advise all women in the world to keep their virtues, take care of their families, and not imitate me so that after death they can avoid the torture of having their hands amputated and their bodies no longer the same as when they were alive.

Prison: Women are the head of the family but forget their responsibilities as housekeepers and go out to gamble, ruining social customs, but when this person was alive, she was not cunning and used gambling to make a living, so the King of Hell reduced his contempt.

Duong Sinh: I would like to ask Ngu Quan, you guys make a living by gambling, specializing in cheating, it is not clear where you will be punished.

Jail: Those souls are not under the authority of the prison but are strictly punished by the Seventh Palace of the Mountain King. Advise the world that anyone who has committed the above sin should quickly correct his mistake and print the book Hell's Journey as a gift to advise the world that his sin can be eliminated and after death he will not come to this hell to be punished.

Buddhist worship: Time is up, we are preparing to return to the Sacred Hall.

Duong Sinh: Thank you Prison Officer for your guidance, we must return to the living world, please say goodbye.

Jail Officer: No formalities, I respectfully bid you two farewell.

Buddhist worship: Yang Sinh, quickly get out of prison, prepare to go to the lotus.

Duong Sinh: I am ready, please return to Thanh Hien Duong.

noi_dung:
Chapter Twenty-Seven

A TRAVEL TO POISONOUS BEES IN HELL

Living Buddha Te Gong Christmas on the 6th day of the third month of the year Dinh Ti (1977)

Poetry

Taking refuge in the Buddha's teachings shows simple success
Throwing down the sword to destroy the devil
The four upright, three-sounding doubts are entrenched
The clear clouds and clouds reach the sky.

Imitate the example of the Buddha to show sincerity
The butcher who puts down the knife and the devil also chants
The Dharma concentrates on the dharma of meditation so he tries to keep
The capital of the immortal world rides on the blue clouds.

Hoering to Buddha: Cultivating to reach a God is not easy, but wanting to be a Saint is even more difficult. In the world, people have established many religions, churches, pagodas, and shrines with brilliantly displayed signs, speaking sutras, discussing religious principles, meditating and realizing enlightenment, which is a place to save sentient beings, it is paradise on earth. Recently, there have been many people who have abused the name of gods, done shady things and lost their virtues, sold gods and sold saints, painted wooden statues, performed all kinds of deceitful tricks, deceived fools to make money, tarnished the gods, and their mistakes are countless. The crime of harming people is not small, the laws of the underworld are strict and absolutely unforgiving. Today I took Duong Sinh to visit hell, to be a mirror of ancient times for the world to look at. Duong Sinh prepares to walk to the underworld and quickly climbs to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Obey orders, I'm ready, I wonder where to go today?

Buddha Sacrifice: Poison Bee Hell. Close your eyes and prepare to leave.

Duong Sinh: I have closed my eyes, please depart.

Duong Sinh: Ah! The Poison Bee Hell appeared before our eyes. The devil escorted many guilty souls into prison. Along the way, they were beaten with sticks and whips so cruelly, they cried bitterly, it sounded so heartbreaking, I don't know what crime they committed?

Saying to Buddha: When we were still alive, we relied on the gods for our livelihood. When he was alive, he ate a lot, so after death he was under the control of the underworld. If he wanted to know more, he had to go inside the prison to observe. The Prison Officer and the General are already waiting to welcome us. Come and show us quickly.

Duong Sinh: My disciple Duong Sinh would like to introduce himself to the Prison Officer and the Generals. Dear, I am a disciple of Saint

Duong Sinh: Thank you. Wow! The teacher and son did not dare to go in anymore, inside was full of honey bees, each one was as big as a thumb, black, just like a "tiger-headed bee" flying into the prison to sting the criminals. Everyone was screaming, wanting to hide but couldn't, falling all over the corner of the wall. There were a few flying towards me. Because the body of the sinful soul inherently has an unjust aura, it likes to come close. As the place is clean, flies and mosquitoes stay away. Stinking things like flies and mosquitoes followed. This poisonous bee flies out to welcome us.

Duong Sinh: So strange! Fireworks explode without harming people because they are ceremonial firecrackers to welcome guests.

Jail: Please come first to visit. Duong Thien Sinh, don't be afraid, if a bee stung everyone we met, we would have run away. This poisonous bee is a divine object, specializing in stinging those who lie in the world, borrow names, and masquerade as gods to make money. Now they want to run away but can't, and because their sinful souls want to run away, they are even more closely followed by the bees. Duong Sinh saw that the soul's body had been stung by bees and was swollen in lumps, especially on the head, and his breasts were swollen. Being tormented by the venom, the body aches and cries like rain, each person holds their head and runs like a duck.

Duong Sinh: The punishment is too cruel, the prison is small and narrow, the guilty soul is chased by bees, wants to run away but has no place, no door, and doesn't know who to call. I would like to ask the Prison Officer, what crime did these souls commit that warrants being exiled here to endure this painful punishment?

Jail: To write in Hell's Journey, I opened the prison door and asked a few souls to recount their evil deeds when they were alive to warn people.

Buddhist worship: Very good. Now all the prisons of the underworld know that their teachers and students are serving as guides to the underworld to write the book Hell's Journey, looking for evidence to warn the world. Please, Prison Officer, let me clearly know the crimes of the criminals.

Jail Officer: That is the duty of local officials. Let me temporarily release the two guilty souls so that they can declare the evil deeds they did while they were alive so that Duong Thien Sinh can clearly understand them and not say too much.

Duong Sinh: Please ask the soul, what crime did you commit when you were alive? Why are you banished to this prison to endure torture?

Sinful Soul: Saying it out makes me even more embarrassed, I still have the face to see other people. I am a friend of the Sacred Sage Hall in Southern Taiwan. I have studied religion for many years. After being elected as Vice President of Thanh Hien Hall, I once wanted to expand the religion so I wrote a book and printed it for places that believed in good things. I tried my best to endure hardships, and places that admired me also wanted to print a lot of it to help people. Because thanks to my speaking skills, in just over two months I earned over thirty thousand dong. At that time, I owed a debt to someone, and they urged me not to know what to do. Nhan had over thirty thousand dong available, so he took out a portion to pay the debt. In the end, he only gave the Road Master twenty thousand dong, keeping twelve thousand four hundred fifty-six dong. After paying off the debt, I put it away for personal use, thinking that no one would know. But from then on, regret tormented my heart, and there was always a feeling of instability towards my benefactor. Every time I sit at the organ, my benefactor never mentions my greed for money. Three years ago, I had a severe stomachache and soon collapsed, and was escorted away by a general with a buffalo head and a horse face. At that time, my benefactor came before me

screamed and scolded: "You think wrong things, until you die you won't wake up. When you were alive, there were some confusing points, why didn't you tell me clearly? The Buddha came down to preach the Dharma mainly to advise people to practice good things and abandon evil. The whole truth is the way to practice religion to teach people how to behave. If you have read the teachings of the saints but did not follow the teachings, now you have to bear the sin, then try to bear it." In addition, he told the underworld soldiers to report to Minh Vuong to increase the punishment. When I got to the underworld, Minh Vuong was very angry and ordered me to be escorted to the Evil Karma Mirror Station to show the acts of printing books to use money to spend in his own pocket. There was not a single point that was not clearly shown, making me tremble and fear. After being handed over to Tu Dien to be judged by Ngu Quan Vuong, I was sentenced to twenty-eight years in prison and imprisoned in this Poison Bee Prison, then transferred to Ngu Dien to handle. Every day in prison, I was stung by bees and my whole body was in unbearable pain. My body was swollen. Whenever the poisonous bees saw me, they would chase me. The prison is too narrow to escape. I regret that when I was still alive, studying at Thanh Hien Duong, being a disciple of my benefactor, disobeying the holy teachings, even though I only committed a crime once, I still did not receive a reprieve.I hope that you all will be very careful with your behavior and language. If you make a mistake, it will be difficult for God to escape. It's too late for me to regret it now. It's a waste of my kindness to my teacher and fellow believers to guide me. I'm so ashamed.

Prisoner: You enter the holy gate, do not accept the holy teachings, it can be said that you despise teachers, despise people, are disrespectful to teachers on the top, disrespectful to the people who spend money to print scriptures. For those who have truly developed the heart to make offerings, people are not afraid of fake monks and monks. Once the alms-giver has developed the heart, the merit cannot be reduced, only those who are greedy for money and have bad hearts will arise, committing great sins. Everyone who has entered the holy door, even a penny or a penny must be clear, otherwise it will pollute the pure religion at the holy door, and hell will increase the punishment. People have to be very careful.

Saying to Buddha: Those who corrupt the holy door, impure money, destroy honor, are crimes worthy of death, punishment in the underworld will not be forgiven. It has been said that as a person in the world, cultivating the religion must keep the teachings and morals pure, so that after death, we can avoid falling into hell and suffering painful punishment. Only then will we regret it and we have already missed it. Today's time is over, come back tomorrow. Duong Sinh prepares to return to Thanh Hien Duong, thanking Ngu Quan for his thoughtful guidance.

Duong Sinh: Thank you Prison Officer and General for helping to find out the prison's internal affairs. Because time is limited, I would like to take your leave.

Jail: Generals, please line up neatly to see you off, hoping to welcome you back to prison another day.

Duong Sinh: I'm ready, please return to Thanh Hien Hall.

Holy Immortal saves with thick grace

If anyone enters the holy door and violates the holy rules, the law judges the crime to be very serious. Today, Duong Sinh prepares to walk to the underworld and quickly climb to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: I'm ready, I don't know where to go today?

noi_dung:
Chapter Forty-Three

HELL BAKED HANDS

Living Buddha Ji Cong Christmas day, November 26, year of Dinh Ti (1977)

Poetry

On the top of the sky, the snow presses mei
The heartless year of the moon, the same thing
The knife is thrown down, the two hands are on the ground
The earth is recommended to cultivate the evil jade smear.

Translation

The mountain top is covered with snow
Unknowingly, the years keep passing by
Throwing the butcher's knife with both clean hands
The earth spirit advised me to cultivate the jade cup.

Buddhist worship: Snowflakes flutter on the cold mountain top, the end of the year and month has come, advise students to throw the butcher knife, not to create new bad karma. Today, preparing to visit the underworld, Duong Sinh ascended the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: The weather is too cold, I'm afraid I won't be able to bear it and ask my teacher for the elixir, is that okay?

Buddhist worship: It's just because of psychological influence, is the spirituality endowed by God afraid of the cold? I asked for medicine, but you have a generous nature, so let me take this medicine quickly and go on my way.

Duong Sinh: Thank you, Master, for giving me medicine and forgiving me of my sins of attachment. I'm ready, I invite you to set out....

Buddhist worship: We've arrived, quickly get down to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Which prison are you visiting today? Why haven't we seen the Prison Officer come out to welcome us? We only see the underworld soldiers escorting the guilty souls back and forth.

Buddhist worship: Let's try to go a little further and we will understand.

Duong Sinh: Well, up ahead is the Hot and Painful Hell. I visited it last time and now I'm going to visit it again?

Buddhist Worship: No, today we are going to visit the Hand-Roasted Prison. To get to this prison, we have to cross the small road next to the Hot and Illusionary Prison.

Duong Sinh: The heat ahead is boiling, how can we cross? Besides, I've heard that that road is a hot road, and my feet are mortal, so how can I avoid getting burned?

Praying to Buddha: Don't be afraid, if I walk next to you, the hot ground will turn into cool ground.

Duong Sinh: I respectfully ask the teacher to bless me so that I can't pass, because the small road ahead is red brick as if burned by fire.

Buddhist offerings: Look at me performing magic, Buddha fanning a fan makes the red fire path turn into a cool, peaceful path that is easy to cross.

Duong Sinh: Truly a boundless Buddha's magic, the bright red road suddenly turned into a cool road. There were a number of sinful souls who passed by without any harm to their bodies, making everyone much more surprised. They looked bewildered in all directions as the sinful souls rushed past.

Duong Sinh: He crossed his arms and followed his teacher until he reached his destination. On the left side of the road, he saw a Prison Officer and a General waiting in line to welcome him.

Buddhist worship: This is the Prison Officer and the General of the Hand Roasted Prison, come quickly and greet them.

Duong Sinh: Hello Prison Officers and Generals, I am Duong Thien Sinh of the Taichung Holy Sage Hall, on orders to follow the Buddhist priest to the prison to collect evidence to write a book to advise and educate people to do good deeds. Today I come here to receive many beneficial teachings.

Jail Officer: We welcome you two to visit this prison, Hell's Journey will publish the testimonies of this prison, it is truly an honor. We would like to invite you two to visit the prison.

Duong Sinh: Thank you very much, Prison Officer, for being so attentive. The words "Hell Roasting Hands" appear on the prison door, on both sides there are soldiers holding weapons guarding very strictly.

Jail Officer: Please come inside.

Duong Sinh: I heard a sad cry.

Buddhist worship: The prisons all mourned bitterly, sounding like the sound of people on earth groaning when they are sick, sadly waiting for salvation.

Duong Sinh: The prison door is equipped with extremely advanced scientific equipment. The guilty soul's hands were tied tightly to the red-hot iron axle with fire running through it. The guilty soul's hands were burned, wanting to pull them out but couldn't. The heat of the iron vehicle axle was too intense, lacking elasticity, so it transferred heat very quickly. The soul wanted to escape but could not reduce the heat of the fire, so it fell over, its hands were like two burning coals, wanting to throw them away but could not, its face was sweating and tears pouring down, its hands were burned in pain and crying.

Jail: This prison is called Hand Roasting Prison. In the past, a hot iron was used to iron the hands. Later, thanks to the combination of people's clever tricks, this punishment was improved. Let me escort a few more guilty souls here so they can clearly recount their illegal actions while still alive.

Duong Sinh: Yin and yang are the same, it is true that superior people must be ruled by superior people.

Jail Officer: Poor souls, listen to me: Today, Living Buddha Ji Gong and Duong Thien Sinh of Thanh Hien Duong in Taichung on earth will go down to this prison to collect evidence to admonish people. You should report all illegal actions to educate the world.

Sin Soul: During my life, I was used to playing around indiscriminately, often hiding in the dark and teasing and humiliating women and girls passing by. In my life, I committed this crime more than a dozen times. After my death, I was sentenced to this prison to suffer.

Jail Officer: Waving your hands in disorder will incur this demonic crime.

Sin Soul: When I was a professional, I incited people to sue each other and then wrote lawsuits for them in order to profit. All my life I committed this crime. After my death, Minh Vuong was so angry that he was so angry that when I was alive, I loved to write lawsuits and hurt people with my hands, so I had to burn them, so I was banished to this prison to pay the penalty. In extreme pain that no one knows about, I respectfully ask Buddha Living Ji Cong to save my life.

Buddha: Since you are well versed in your expertise, why don't you write a petition against the King of Hell to ask for forgiveness.

Sinful Soul: The iron-faced King of Hell is carefree, I don't dare to trouble myself.

Buddha worship: Of course, but asking for help is no different.

Prisoner: Do not beg arbitrarily. The third guilty soul must confess quickly.

Sin Soul: When I was living, I opened a casino and often played fraudulent gambling games, so I earned a lot of money. When I lived, because I had money so easily, I lived a well-off life, so I often acted unjustly and harmed society. Only after my death did the King of Hell become so angry that he banished me to the Hand Roasting Prison for thirty years, suffering unbearably every day.

Buddhist worship: Having opened a casino, it also organizes fraudulent gambling, the crime of humanity is too cruel, if after completing the prison term and being reborn as a human, both hands will surely be disabled, which is a bad karma, I hope people will quickly wake up and quit gambling. The fourth guilty soul quickly declares the crimes it has committed.

Sin: When I was alive, I often used unsecured checks to defraud others of money, and after I died, I was imprisoned in this prison. When he was alive, he only thought that he could fly far away and be caught by creditors who would not know where to claim him. Who would have thought that when he died, he would go to the underworld and the King of Hell would bring him here to be punished.

Jail: If you owe someone you should have paid it fairly, on the contrary, you deliberately deceived yourself, so after your death you were severely punished, it was not unfair at all.

Buddhist offerings: Nowadays, people use unsecured checks a lot. Cashing out a check and then hiding like that is a fraud, and after death, of course, he will be severely punished. In the next life, one will have to become a buffalo or a horse to repay karma. From time immemorial, no one will be lucky enough to escape. Karma and retribution cannot be escaped by even a hair or a thread, so people should be careful.

Prisoner: Fifth sinful soul, why have you lost all your spirit? Please quickly reveal the crimes committed while you were alive.

Sinful Soul: Please don't make fun of me. When I was living in a dishonest party, I often got into trouble and disturbed security in society. Whenever I encountered something wrong or suddenly saw someone staring at me, I immediately raised my hand to attack, assaulting people like that without considering it important. After his death, Minh Vuong sent a ghost with a buffalo head and horse face to torture me and asked me if I would submit? Reminds me of the actions I did when I was alive that cannot be rectified.

Jail Officer: When you were a young man, you used to have strong firepower, specializing in beating people, destroying social security, your fist was too hard, now it's better to ask you to punch the iron and steel axle of the car so that it can exhaust all your firepower.

Buddhist offerings: The time has come, Duong Sinh quickly returns to Thanh Hien Hall.

Duong Sinh: Saying goodbye to the Prison Mandarins and Generals, thank you for your warm hospitality and advice.

Jail Officer: It's nothing, it's just a small ceremony. Order the Generals to arrange a neat send-off.

Buddhist worship: Duong Sinh quickly go to the lotus.

Duong Sinh: Dear teacher, I have finished preparing and would like to invite you back to Thanh Hien Hall.....

Buddha worship: Having arrived at Thanh Hien Hall, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus, his soul entered his body.

noi_dung:
Chapter Forty-Four

A TRAVELING TO HELL

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas day, November 29, year of Dinh Ti (1977)

Poetry

Loaning the magic pen into the Nine Chuan Dan
Reviving the living arts to restore peace
Ten thousand volumes of thousands of books to open up human wisdom
The Jade Emperor's grace and gratitude are never returned

Translation

The sacred pen descends to the mysterious path
Revival has a technique to help calm the mind
The Book of Heaven and Thousand Volumes Opens Mortal Wisdom
The Jade Emperor's grace is not complete.

Buddhist offerings: Human souls traveling to hell is not a myth or myth, from ancient times until now there have been many people who have died and come back to life. Surely those who thoroughly comprehend the sounds and images of hell can describe those scenes easily, enough to prove that the things described in the scriptures are not untrue. People just don't believe because they haven't personally seen it, so what they say is known but is suspected of being delusional. How can this be explained? The six internal organs in our body are also an object that cannot be seen but is still safe and sound. But if we discover it soon or feel that the time has come, it will be very tragic. If this area hurts, it also hurts in another area, requiring X-rays and surgery. People in everyday life cannot clearly see the internal organs, can they say that they are not there? Hell is normally invisible, but it still exists. Except for a few people who can see it while they are alive. For others, once they see hell, they will be nearing the end of their lives from Heaven.The reason why I advise people to be enlightened, to confirm that things that are invisible but still exist such as thoughts, breathing, emotions, etc. are all invisible and can only be understood by feeling. Besides, those things that cannot be seen are what sustain life, and are the main elements of the body.

Duong Sinh: The teacher's teachings are very moral. Unfortunately, most people do not understand the situation, just like a blind person who cannot see, so they deny it. The world is immersed in a place of shapes and colors, only relying on a stick to travel thousands of miles, this proves that our physical eyes are blocked by many obstacles, only the wisdom eye can understand everything. But unfortunately, we have closed our eyes of wisdom and resigned ourselves to living blindly, allowing ourselves to be attracted by lust and immersing ourselves in the sufferings of samsara.

Teacher Buddha: You are right, everyone in the world understands the harm of breaking the law, just like the well in front of them knows that it can fall down but still refuses to open their eyes to see, it is indeed inferior to the blind because they still know how to use a stick to grope their way. When I fell into the ten thousand feet deep cave of hell, I wanted to escape but I didn't know if I had to wait for decades to come. It was late, Duong Sinh prepared to walk to the underworld and quickly climbed to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Dear Master, I have finished my preparations.

Buddhist worship: Seeing that my clothes are covered in dust and not clean and dry, so when I came to Minh Phu, I must have been rude.

Duong Sinh: Dear Master, my clothes were soiled by sand sand dust, I accidentally did not pay attention, please forgive me.

Buddhist offerings: When mortals come to Minh Phu, they cannot help but keep clean, so their clothes must be fragrant to receive special attention and quickly get to the lotus.

Duong Sinh: I have finished preparing, please sir, please depart...

Buddhist worship: Having arrived, Duong Sinh quickly got down on the lotus platform and came to the ceremony to present the Prison Officer.

Duong Sinh: Please obey. Respect the Prison Officer and the Generals.

Prison Mandarin: No ceremony, welcome Living Buddha Ji Gong and Duong Thien Sinh to visit. This prison soon received a letter from Duong Thien Sinh of Thanh Hien Duong asking for an interview to write a book to advise people. His merit is truly immeasurable. This prison is the Ruined Prison. We invite you both to come inside and visit.

Duong Sinh: Thank you very much to the Prison Officials for your warm hospitality. This was originally the Rut Rut Prison. The underworld soldiers came back and forth, escorting the guilty souls out, and we began to hear screams.

Buddhist worship: Let's quickly follow them inside.

Duong Sinh: He clearly saw the scene in prison, the sinner's body and soul were stained red with blood, tied to pillars, evil soldiers and demon soldiers used knives to slash the soul's stomach, the stomach skin was torn open, the intestines and stomach were protruding and falling to the ground, next to a pack of black dogs fighting to bite each other. Even though the intestines and stomach had fallen out, they were still attached to the heart because the heart had not yet left the body, so when the dog bit and chewed and tore them, the guilty soul roared in pain and fainted, making it difficult for the eyes to look at it. May I ask, Prison Officer, what crime did they commit that warranted being exiled to this prison?

Jail: When these sinners were alive, they were all corrupt or corrupt souls, so after they died, they came to this prison to be executed, as if wanting to understand the situation, so I sent a few sinners here to be interrogated.

Duong Sinh: That's very good, there must be real evidence for people to believe it's true.

Jail Officer: I have brought out the guilty souls and invited Duong Thien Sinh to interrogate them.

Duong Sinh: May I ask you, poor soul, why did you come to this place?

Sin Soul: When I was a mandarin, I often took advantage of the mandarin's means to confiscate wealth and land, stealing without profit. Whatever means is beneficial, I will take advantage of all methods of raping it to make it my own. Unexpectedly, after death, he was put on a mirror platform to examine his bad karma to reveal his true nature. All the greedy actions of raping money and wealth were clearly visible, making me extremely horrified. After going through the courts of judgment, in the end I was taken to the Seventh Palace and then King Thai Son ordered me to be imprisoned in a disemboweled prison. Every day my stomach and intestines were taken out for the dogs to compete for food, the suffering is hard to imagine.

Jail Officer: You are a person with a position in the government, you don't take care of the welfare of hundreds of people, and you even peel off the skin and flesh of thousands of people. As long as you can swallow, you can swallow, your intestines and stomach are really filthy right now! Advise those who are officials in the world that because of their responsibility to serve the people, they must always love the people and be loyal to the country, which will bring immeasurable merit. If it's just for profit, after death you will definitely be damned to hell.

Duong Sinh: Please ask the old woman again, why is this old woman still being given this kind of punishment? Did she do something inappropriate when she was young?

Sinful Soul: Remembering the time of life and now regretting it is too late. When I was 48 years old, due to business losses, I became the owner of the family. I lost my reason for a moment and decided to steal the family's money and move to another country. At the age of 54, I fell ill and was taken to the Seventh Palace. The King of Hell ordered me to be exiled here to serve my sentence.

Jail Officer: I snatched someone's vomit, swallowed it and then vomited it out. Now I have no choice but to vomit my intestines and stomach out. I pay as much as I eat. The law in the underworld is very fair, you do it yourself, the day after your sentence is over, you will be reincarnated to pay your debt.

Duong Sinh: May I ask how long you will serve in this prison?

Sin: It took three years. When I was born, my family lived by farming, specializing in growing vegetables for a living. Somehow, when I was middle-aged, legumes were often damaged by insects, so I had to use insecticides to kill them. When I saw the price of vegetables skyrocketing, I picked vegetables that had only been sprayed for a day or two and sold them. Just like that, after his death, Minh Vuong was sentenced to exile in prison for unintentionally causing harm.

Jail: You were only worried about making money, so you sold poisonous beans and legumes, causing many people to be poisoned. Many people who ate your beans were poisoned, or the toxins accumulated enough to cause liver disease, cancer, and your stomach was too toxic, so you had to receive this punishment.

Duong Sinh: May I ask the old lady why she had to come here?

Sinful Soul: Alas! Oh my God! It's so miserable in here, please save my life.

Buddhist worship: Right now I love you very much, but remember why you didn't have mercy on others in the past? Please quickly explain the reason for your crime.

Sinful Soul: Yes, I have an adopted daughter, since I was little I didn't love her and often beat her. When she was older, because she was beautiful, I forced her to sell her to a prostitute to get money. After my death, I was exiled here by the King of Hell.

Prison: The evil heart, considering the adopted daughter as an object to make money, destroying morality, destroying the truth of God, the heart of steel is truly sinful.

Buddhist worship: Time was tight, Duong Sinh prepared to return to Thanh Hien Hall.

Duong Sinh: I still have a problem asking my teacher for advice. While being executed, there are some souls who have fallen into a coma and become unconscious. How can they be brought back to life for further punishment?

Buddhist worship: Have you ever dreamed that someone else killed you? If so, is it possible that the body felt extremely painful at that time but when it woke up, there was only cold sweat flowing profusely, and it was not dead? The next night I fell asleep again, and after waking up, I found myself as before, my body still intact with no injuries at all. The reason why after a person dies, their soul is just like when they sleepwalk, although their body is tortured and tortured, the ghosts use water to restore their soul, but when they wake up, they don't see any injuries at all. Doing so is just to make them remember the terrifying feeling of suffering. The torture in the underworld is just to awaken people's spirituality, that's why death is likened to a big dream, so when people die, they must go into a long dream to taste suffering. Another example is when dreaming about picking up gold, being crazy happy, but when you wake up it's not completely empty, showing that illusions cannot be real but are mistakenly believed by deluded people. If a worldly cultivator does not enlighten to this point and remains fixated on form, name and form, he will eventually fall into a long dream.

Duong Sinh: Ah so that's it! Dear teacher, I have finished preparing, please come and say goodbye to the Prison Officer and the Generals.

Jail Officer: Ordered the Generals to pay a proper farewell....

Buddhist offerings: Having arrived at the Thanh Hien Hall, Duong Sinh got down on the lotus platform, his soul entering his body.

Chapter Forty-Five

WALK IN HELL ON THE STONE

Living Buddha Ji Cong Christmas on December 9, Year of the Tiger (1977)

Poetry

Respecting the teacher, virtue, and obedience
Dieu of flowers and leaves, total return to base
Prioritization of reciting the origin and understanding of true nature
Ingratitude and ungratefulness.

Respecting the teacher's karma and karma should
Flowers and fallen leaves all return to the source
Remembering the root to understand the true nature
Be ungrateful and ungrateful.

I hope that after the new year, people will spur their horses and whip them, otherwise the horse will not be a horse, a tiger will not be a tiger, the shout will be like a spring breeze passing through the horse's ears. Cultivating the Way should learn the character of a horse that always strives for the invincible spirit and is not afraid of difficult obstacles. But if you let go, no matter where you go, if you soon find yourself old, it would be difficult to catch up with four horses. Today, preparing to visit the underworld, Duong Sinh quickly climbed up to the lotus platform.

NOTE 2

Try to do something.

Duong Sinh: I'm ready, I invite you to go on your way, I'm not sure which prison we'll visit today.

Buddha Sacrifice: Will go to the Stone Team's Buckling Back Prison under the control of the Seventh Palace. Preparing to depart.... having arrived at the Stone-Headed Hell, Duong Thien Sinh quickly got down to the lotus platform.

Duong Sinh: Sure enough, after just a moment it arrived, when sitting on the lotus in front of Thanh Hien Hall, closing his eyes tightly like sitting on a jet plane, just hearing the "whoosh" sound in his ears, he reached hell.

Duong Sinh: Please obey. Hello Prison Officials and Generals, I am Duong Sinh of Thanh Hien Duong. Today, our teachers and students have come to the prison to inquire about the situation and respectfully ask the Prison Officials for help.

Duong Sinh: Thank you Prison Officer... inside the guilty souls are working, both big and small are carrying rocks, are the prison guards building new rooms?

Jail: New rooms are not built here, the souls of criminals must wear stones because that is a kind of punishment.

Duong Sinh: When the guilty souls carry rocks, they cry loudly, which is not surprising because they have to carry rocks that are too large, holding them tightly with both hands, hunching over as if exhausted, each step only moving about an inch. Some people could not bear their strength, the falling rock crushed them or crushed their leg bones, they lay unconscious, the soldiers scooped water and immediately woke up, picked up the rock and put it on their head and continued walking. This punishment has existed since ancient times, but now it is also quite useful to use it to punish criminals!

Jail: These sinful souls are practicing "iron head gong" (iron head gong) because they are stubborn, arrogant people in life, like to be worldly teachers, do not love purity, do not respect teachers, so after death they have to come here to practice.

Duong Sinh: Please call the prison officials here so I can ask them what crimes they committed during their lives?

Jail Officer: Very good, let me order to call some guilty souls here so that they can clearly reveal their mistakes while alive to serve as a lesson for life... the guilty souls have come, invite Duong Sinh to interrogate.

Duong Sinh: May I ask why you have to come here to play football?

Sinful Soul: It's embarrassing to say the least, when I was a professor, I took advantage of my existing prestige to lure beautiful female students into prostitution. While alive, although evil things are not revealed, after death it is difficult to escape from the third eye of the iron-faced King of Hell. When I arrived at Hell, the soldiers of the underworld and the King of Hell ordered me to be beaten with whips, then delivered to the Seventh Palace. King Thai Son saw me angry, my hair standing on end, scolded me for being an animal, being a teacher but not keeping my body pure, and humiliating female students, and sentenced me to be imprisoned in prison with my back bent over a stone and unable to raise my head.

Jail Officer: You are a teacher and have no shame and have sex with female students, your crime is too cruel. Now I'm forcing you to wear a stone until your head is broken, your anger is gone, you have no face to see anyone anymore, so that you are no longer ashamed. Advice to those who are teachers in the world, whether they are gurus, professors or hundreds of artists, farmers, industrialists and merchants, if they do not have a teacher to teach them, their craft will not be good. Teachers and students are like father and children, they should be treated with respect, and must not go beyond the rules in order to avoid punishment from Heaven. Invite Duong Thien Sinh to continue questioning.

Duong Sinh: I would like to ask the poor soul, looking at your appearance, you also seem to be practicing, your head is bald, why do you still have to come here to "practice"?

Sinful Soul: Please don't make fun of me, I have to shave my head because wearing a stone makes my hair feel unbearably painful. When I was alive, I was a scholarly scholar. Everyone who understands the scriptures should be able to teach the truth to others and not arrogantly call himself a teacher. If you do not follow this advice, you will be banished to prison with your back hunched over and carrying a stone. Every day you will have to bend over and carry a stone while walking to eliminate bad karma.

Buddhist worship: Talented scholars must take care to develop their full potential. Since ancient times, there have been many cases where students were better than their teachers. But in today's world, there are many people who are too realistic and have not learned the trade well, so they quickly leave their teachers and leave school to make money, and are ungrateful and ungrateful towards their former teachers. Show off to show off appearances but in reality there is nothing.

Duong Sinh: Many thanks to the Prison Officer. We have troubled you Generals too much, please say goodbye.

Chapter Forty-Six

A TRAVEL IN HELL THE BOILING OIL CALDEL

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas January 23, Year of the Horse (1978)

Poetry

The direction is like a stream of tears
Caring for pleasure in retirement
Opening doubts to gain spring's wind
The first point of the moon is the harp and stone.

Translation

Learning the Dharma is like the tears of a candle
Eagerly waiting for the time to rest

Living Buddha Ji Gong Christmas February 3, Year of the Horse (1978)

The world of competition is boring

The waves of the Truong Giang class will push the previous class, in life, new people will have to replace the old people. Duong Sinh: Please obey. In front of the temple, the sound of chanting can be heard, and the music sending people off to the Western Pure Land can be heard faintly.

Hell specializes in the evildoers.

Saying to Buddha: Heaven only accepts those who study the Dharma, cultivate virtue, and are truly gentle. Hell, on the contrary, specializes in welcoming people who are cruel, virtuous, deceitful and scoundrels. Because the two places are not the same, the reception objects are also different. Just like where a casino opens its doors to welcome like-minded fellow believers, if you don't feel interested in gambling, the general guarding the door will forbid you from taking a step past the Thunder Pond (Loi Tri). How many times have I come here to meet you, but this time I'm here to read Hell's Journey and it's up to the Superiors to forgive you. Read so that we can enjoy, learn together, and wake up together. It is a very fortunate opportunity to save practitioners of great age.I hope that those who continue will achieve better than me and be better than me, and will dedicate your sounds to save sentient beings according to the unfolding path of God's will so that everyone has the opportunity to move forward easily, no longer being oppressed, no longer crushed. Therefore, many people will appear from the mass of non-action all over the world. Many people who have worked hard to cultivate will then appear. They are not isolated, they advance in level, they destroy their delusions and attachments. One day they will contribute, one day they will be stuffed with more fruit to make them lighter. Don't see them making a few mistakes and then being punished, then criticizing, then cursing at them, that shouldn't be the case. We consciously see that the way to evolve is to suffer. Seeing that Duong Thien Sinh and Phat Te Cong still had to walk in a dark and gloomy place looking for documents to contribute to us. Ask people to attain enlightenment, why should they follow us? We ourselves must follow them, but because compassion is power, that power has come to us. Luckily, we are more or less stupid, no matter how stupid we are, we still have to learn a little compassion to be human. People who lack compassion only deceive and kill themselves.We must try and clearly understand the path we have been following in the law of non-action: past impurities flow and open, destroy all impurities within the mind towards purity and to cooperate with the Great Purity. In this upcoming fate, many things will change. Those who aim towards the Great Purity will have the opportunity to work and head straight towards it to save sentient beings. That's why we have to do our own merit, and no one gives it to us. Today you have a method to practice and remind yourself that the karma in the family always follows us. We must find a way to separate it and guide it forward. Only then can we learn the Buddhist word Courage. You are very lucky, after practicing non-action you will feel that you are progressing very quickly. Before, when you read the sutras, you didn't understand them. Now, when you read the sutras, you can deeply understand any sutra if you practice according to the legal guidelines. You feel yourself being stagnant, slow progressing, dependent, forgetting your own honesty and not using your own honesty. Our honesty is purity, compassion, and clarity, we must keep that.We wish for our juniors to do better, we wish for a better society, we wish for a Heaven that can be close to humans. But people themselves do not want to be close to Heaven, but only closer to Hell, making mistakes and deceiving themselves too much. So we have the opportunity to know how many Saints have reminded us to become a Saint. Today we try to return to purity. You just let it go, in your mind just let it go, don't harbor anger or sadness anymore, let it go; Only by living in moments of leisure will you be able to nurture that bond of leisure, then you will move forward. The more you move forward, the world sees you suffering but you are happy. Guanyin attained enlightenment in suffering, Buddhas attained enlightenment in suffering. Only through suffering do we know the value of patience. We have suffered a lot. Coming here, we have suffered a lot, but we have reaped the rewards, only learning two words, patience. Wherever you go, they will discriminate against you, not respect you. You must remember this and continue to learn the word patience.To aim for nobility, we do not have to defeat them, but to dedicate that nobility to them, to help them become more perfect, they will be better and live together with all brothers and sisters on earth, lovingly and in harmony with God and Buddha. Gods and Buddhas have worked very hard and suffered a lot, but today they have achieved enlightenment and always look towards us and want to save us, want to guide us and not abandon us. It is we who abandon God and Buddha, using God and Buddha like rags, wanting to do wrong when we want but not doing it. That is, you lie down at night feeling guilty, you have to repent, you have to make amends while you are still alive, in this opportunity to be human, we practice, we must practice, we must be honest with ourselves and not continue to deceive ourselves. Any dirty nature, any anger or ignorance will be eliminated, to gain the consciousness of harmony, love, and forgiveness. This is essential. All three realms are waiting for sentient beings to contribute in this final period.
